data.jd_text:
**Location:** 
 Dubai, UAE (Hybrid)
   

  

**Reports to:** 
 Global PMO Lead
   

  

**About The Role**
 This role exists to help build and embed a fit\-for\-purpose PMO capability for the Emerging Markets (EM) business, enabling disciplined execution of innovation and portfolio priorities at pace and with quality.
   

  

 As Flora Food Group continues to scale consumer\-led innovation across regions, the Emerging Markets business requires stronger orchestration across Marketing, R\&D, Supply Chain, Finance and Operations. The PMO Manager will act as a foundational builder of this capability: setting up robust ways of working, driving executional discipline, and ensuring projects land on time, in full, and with clear accountability.
   

  

 This role is critical to reducing execution risk, improving speed\-to\-market, and freeing up functional leaders to focus on content and decision\-making rather than coordination.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 Operating at the intersection of strategy and execution, you will help establish an Emerging Markets PMO operating/ framework model aligned to global P\&P / PMO standards, while tailored to local business realities.
   

  

 You will bring consistency, transparency and rigor to how innovation and portfolio initiatives are planned, governed and delivered, and act as the single point of truth for execution status, risks and delivery confidence across the EM innovation and portfolio agenda.
   

  

 You will act as the executional backbone for end\-to\-end project \& activity management, by owning the planning and orchestration of priority innovation and portfolio initiatives, ensuring cross\-functional teams’ ownership and accountability to deliver against clear timelines, milestones and decision gates.
   

  

 You will improve delivery confidence, resource visibility and decision quality across the EM portfolio by ensuring high\-quality data, discipline and follow\-through in portfolio \& project management systems. You will act as a role model for execution discipline, pragmatic problem\-solving and collaborative leadership; and you will help to build the EM PMO capability over time, including a small team, templates/tools, playbooks and best practices, as the EM hub scales.
   

  

**What This Role Is (and Is Not)**
 You will be
 **accountable for execution and orchestration** 
 , not for project content ownership. Project leadership and strategic direction will remain with the Marketing / Business leads; this role ensures the work lands.
   

  

 You are biased toward action, clarity and simplification — not to add bureaucracy.
   

  

**What Does It Take To Be Successful**
 You combine strong project management fundamentals with the confidence to operate in complex, cross\-functional FMCG environments. You are comfortable building structure where it does not yet exist, and you bring calm, clarity and momentum to ambiguous situations.
   

  

* 5–10\+ years’ experience in project, program or PMO roles within FMCG / CPG or similarly complex environments
* Experience acting as owner of PMO data quality, reporting cadence and execution dashboards in enterprise environments
* Strong systems thinker with the ability to design simple, scalable ways of working, with proven experience setting up or scaling PMO / project management structures
* Hands\-on experience managing end\-to\-end innovation, transformation or portfolio initiatives.
* Strong understanding of stage\-gate models, innovation lifecycles and launch readiness
* Confident facilitator and communicator with experience in influencing senior and cross\-functional stakeholders without direct authority
* Excellent planning, prioritization, execution discipline, high accountability mindset comfortable holding others to commitments and follow\-through for continuous improvement
* Values transparency, pragmatic, solution\-oriented, resilient under pressure and energised by building capability and enabling others to succeed
* Preferred, but not required: PMP, PRINCE2, Agile / SAFe certification.


**What’s next?**
**Flora Food Group** 
 is committed to culinary essentials for better food. We believe fewer, better ideas — executed with excellence — are what drive sustainable growth.
   

  

 This is a career\-defining opportunity to work with our high\-impact brands in a high\-energy, high\-accountability environment. If you recognise yourself in this profile, apply and be part of this exciting journey. Apply now at www.florafoodgroup.com.We prefer to receive your application before
 **25th June 2026** 
 .
   

  

 We understand your resume might not be up to date and recommend that you apply with what you have or your LinkedIn Profile. Flora Food Group is dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workplace, we understand that you might not meet all the requirements stated in the description, but we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the right candidate for this role or other roles.
   

  

*Flora Food Group is an employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace and equal opportunities for all. We recruit based only on values, qualifications, performance, skills, behaviours, experience, and knowledge. We ensure job advertisements are free from unintentional bias.*
*No personal characteristics should be a barrier to joining Flora Food Group. We prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or other personal characteristics.*

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
 As the PMO, you will be the central focal point for the COO to monitor, track, and synchronize all cross\-departmental efforts. Your primary mission is to optimize the Payment Integration Lifecycle and manage the high\-stakes intersection of Product, Engineering, Sales, and Compliance. You will turn strategic vision into a structured, visible, and predictable execution roadmap.
   

  

**Job Requirements**
* Experience: 5\+ years in Project/Program Management, with 3\+ years specifically in Fintech, Payments, or Orchestration, 1\+ years in Leading 2\+ members team.
* Technical Literacy: Strong understanding of API\-based architectures, Webhooks, and Payment Flow Logic.
* Tools: Expert\-level mastery of Jira/Confluence and specialized PMO software.
* Location Awareness: Familiarity with the fintech ecosystem. And willngness to get into a new locations and learn.
* Strong proficiency in integrating AI tools into daily workflows to drive efficiency, quality, and innovation
* Education: Degree in Business, Engineering, or Computer Science. PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile certifications are highly preferred.


**Job Responsibilities**
**Strategic Oversight \& COO Support**
* The Focal Point: Serve as the "Single Source of Truth" for the COO, providing a consolidated view of all global projects.
* Executive Reporting: Design and maintain real\-time dashboards (Jira/Monday/Tableau) that track project health, resource utilization, and delivery velocity.
* Cross\-Functional Orchestration: Lead weekly synchronization meetings between Department Heads to resolve dependencies and resource conflicts.


**Integration \& Product Delivery**
* Payment Pipeline Management: Own the end\-to\-end lifecycle of new PSP/Bank integrations—from initial API documentation review to Production Go\-Live.
* Process Engineering: Standardize the "Integrations Playbook" to reduce Time\-to\-Market for new payment rails.
* Agile Governance: Partner with Engineering and Product leads to ensure sprint capacity matches commercial priorities.


**Operational Excellence**
* Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify "at\-risk" projects and provide the COO with remediation options (Trade\-offs, Resource shifts).
* Compliance Alignment: Ensure all projects meet the regulatory  standards of PCI DSS, PSD2 and any specific jurisdiction requirements.


**Job Benefits**
* Competitive salary package aligned with experience and market standards.
* Medical Insurance starting from day 1\.
* Access to training resources and development opportunities that support your professional growth.
* Well\-stocked office with snacks, drinks, and refreshments available daily.
* A multinational organisation that promotes a strong, collaborative culture
* Regular team\-building events and company activities that strengthen collaboration across teams.
* Employee Recognition Program celebrating our "Employee of the Month" with special perks.

**Summary**
 The role of the Project Manager in the Major Projects \& Engineering Services Department is to lead and guide the execution of all engineering, design, procurement, fabrication, field construction (if applicable), and scope changes from project award, to kick\-off, through project execution, and to field commissioning of natural gas projects in the United States.
   

  

****Principle Responsibilities and Duties****
* Provide overall leadership and governance for large, complex, and high\-risk EPC (turnkey) projects, managing technical, commercial, contractual, and fabrication requirements from initiation through closeout in alignment with Enerflex processes and the Project Execution Plan. Ensure full integration of scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk, procurement, and stakeholder management. Establish project governance structures, decision authorities, and escalation protocols appropriate to major capital projects. Lead and optimize multi\-disciplinary teams while managing multiple concurrent projects with significant execution and commercial risk. Demonstrate ethical leadership, sound judgment, and adherence to Enerflex core values. Advise executive management on project performance, risks, client relationships, and strategic impacts through formal reporting and governance forums.
* Serve as the senior customer interface, owning executive\-level stakeholder relationships throughout the project lifecycle. Build and maintain strong customer relationships through proactive engagement, structured communication, and effective issue resolution. Translate customer requirements, changes, and commercial positions into clear internal direction aligned with the approved scope baseline. Lead high\-impact internal and external meetings, negotiations, and executive reviews. Travel domestically and internationally as required to support customer engagement, commissioning, and start\-up activities.
* Lead or support the development of major EPC proposals, providing input on execution strategy, contracting approach, risk identification, scheduling, and cost structure. Ensure proposal assumptions are carried through post\-award and early execution phases.
* Establish, validate, and approve integrated project schedules and execution plans aligned with contractual milestones and business objectives. Oversee performance reporting, including schedule and cost variance, forecast\-to\-complete, and recovery planning. Proactively identify schedule risks and implement mitigation or acceleration strategies using advanced planning tools and critical path analysis.
* Own overall project financial performance, including margin protection, cash flow, scope control, change management, and forecast accuracy. Oversee cost control activities and apply earned value management, cost forecasting, and commercial risk principles. Lead or support high\-value change orders, variations, and claim negotiations.
* mitigation and constructability. Resolve complex technical, commissioning, and warranty issues, ensuring alignment across engineering, procurement, fabrication, and construction.
* Direct all execution activities, including engineering, procurement, expediting, fabrication, logistics, delivery, and commissioning. Lead negotiations with major suppliers, subcontractors, and partners, and resolve high\-impact execution or interface issues affecting cost, schedule, or quality.
* Ensure compliance with quality, health, safety, security, and environmental (HSSE) requirements. Promote a proactive safety and compliance culture and provide leadership in addressing serious quality or HSSE risks and incidents.
* Own the project risk management plan, ensuring risks, opportunities, and mitigation strategies are actively managed and clearly communicated. Enforce disciplined change management and capture lessons learned while mentoring and developing future project leaders.


**Qualifications**
* 15\+ years of Project Management Experience.
* 15\+ years of engineering, design, applications or sales, EPC (turnkey) and manufacturing shop floor experience.
* Success for this role requires a working knowledge of the equipment and process for amine sweetening, glycol dehydration, hydrocarbon recovery, fractionation, and dew point control.
* Strong self\-starter skills and ability to perform successfully with limited supervision.
* Versatile team building skills and ability to coordinate multifunctional teams.
* Solid Computer/Software/Program skills.
* Strong working knowledge of industry codes and safety legislation.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, organizational skills, and the ability to work closely in a team environment with all internal / external stakeholders.
* Fully comfortable in dealing with customers, vendors, manufacturing and management teams in the USA and international landscapes.
* Strong negotiation and conflict resolution skills.
* EPC Project experience along with exposure to fabrication facilities is a must.
* Entrepreneurial attitude, aptitude for innovation and long term career interests.BS Degree in Engineering is preferred and a Professional Engineering License is a plus.


****Physical Requirements****
 Fast\-paced general office environment. Many tasks have high degrees of time sensitivity. Domestic and international travel is possible on occasion.

**Job Description**
**Application Deadline:** 
 30 June 2026
   

  

**Department:** 
 Central Services, People
   

  

**Location:** 
 Dubai
   

  

**Description**
**A Career with Trivandi**
 Working for Trivandi means the opportunity to work on the world’s most iconic projects in a supportive, people\-first environment with colleagues who are passionate, collaborative and love what they do.
   

  

 Our culture is grounded in trust and fulfilment, with a shared passion for achieving excellence, whilst having fun. We’re dedicated to ensuring that every team member’s voice is heard and valued, enabling Trivandi to be shaped and grown by the people within it.
   

  

 Ultimately, Trivandi is a place where you’ll be excited to come to work at the start of each week.
   

  

 Together, we keep our shared values at the heart of everything we do:
   

  

**Passion** 
 : We love what we do and care passionately about achieving great outcomes with our partners.
   

  

**Trust \& Quality:** 
 We are trusted to consistently deliver to the highest international standards and professional ethics.
   

  

**OneTeam** 
 : We are a close\-knit team and know that our best work is done together. We care for each other, always putting people first, enabling us to deliver our best work.
   

  

**Always Evolving** 
 : We don't stand still. We strive to make each project better than the last, daring to challenge what's gone before, in our quest for innovation and improvement.
   

  

**About Trivandi**
 Trivandi provides advisory, design and delivery services across sport, events, live entertainment and venues.
   

  

 Founded in 2013 from the success of the London 2012 Games, we have grown to over 100 specialists across four global offices in London, Dubai, Riyadh and Brisbane, delivering over 300 projects in 29 countries.
   

  

 Our unique “One Team” approach brings together the right expertise at the right time, synchronising strategy, design, project management, and operations to simplify complexity and deliver actionable solutions that drive meaningful impact.
   

  

 We passionately share our knowledge to empower local teams, unlocking the full potential of each unique experience to inspire positive change and create lasting legacies.
   

  

**About The Role**
 That’s what we mean by creating experiences, better.
   

  

 We are looking for a motivated People Administrator \& PRO to join our People team to support the day\-to\-day People operations and government relations activities for the business in Dubai and KSA, with a strong focus on DMCC processes and compliance.
   

  

 The role is responsible for coordinating employee lifecycle administration, including visa and immigration activities, maintaining employee records, supporting payroll inputs, and acting as the key liaison with DMCC and relevant UAE government authorities.
   

  

 This role requires strong organisational skills, attention to detail, excellent communication skills, and a proactive approach to employee support and compliance management.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will be highly energetic, professional and able to demonstrate integrity and discretion in all tasks. As this role involves handling sensitive personal and company data, you must be able to manage confidential information with the highest level of care and responsibility.
   

  

 To come on this journey with us, you’ll bring a great sense of humour, a positive and collaborative mindset, and the confidence to navigate a fast\-paced and sometimes ambiguous environment. You should be naturally resourceful, solutions\-driven, and comfortable taking initiative. Most importantly, you’ll enjoy a challenge and be excited by the opportunity to support and elevate the People function across all regions as we continue to grow.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 At Trivandi all our roles are broad and flexible, but here’s a flavour of where you’ll focus your time:
   

  

**HR Administration**
* Support day\-to\-day People administration activities across the employee lifecycle including onboarding, employment changes and offboarding.
* Prepare letters, certificates and other HR documentation.
* Maintain accurate employee records and HR databases ensuring all information is up to date and compliant.
* Coordinate onboarding processes for new employees including document collection, inductions and system access requests.
* Track probation periods, visa expiry dates, passport renewals and other key employee milestones.
* Support payroll administration by preparing monthly payroll inputs including leave, allowances, deductions and employee changes.
* Maintain annual leave and attendance records.
* Respond to employee queries relating to HR policies, benefits, visas and company procedures.
* Support the implementation and continuous improvement of HR processes and systems.
* Assist with recruitment coordination including interview scheduling, candidate communication and onboarding administration.
* Ensure all HR practices are compliant with UAE labour law and company policies.


**PRO \& Government Relations Responsibilities**
* Act as the main point of contact for DMCC and relevant UAE government authorities.
* Manage and process employment visas, labour cards, Emirates IDs, medicals and residency permits.
* Coordinate visa applications, renewals, cancellations and status changes for employees
* Maintain accurate tracking of all visa and immigration activities and ensure renewals are completed in advance of expiry dates.
* Ensure compliance with all DMCC regulations and UAE immigration requirements.
* Coordinate document attestation and notarisation processes where required.
* Support WPS and labour\-related administrative requirements.
* Keep up to date with changes to UAE labour law, immigration regulations and DMCC requirements and communicate impacts to the business.
* Support the KSA People team with KSA Business Visa applications and renewals, monitoring expiry dates and turnaround times. Ensure all documentation is complete and correct before employees visit the visa processing centre.


**Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
**Personal Skills And Experience**
 The key knowledge, experience, and qualifications we are looking for include:
   

  

* 1–2 years of experience in Human Resources or People operations in Dubai, ideally within a professional services or fast\-paced environment.
* Strong administration skills developed within a professional setting.
* Experience with HRMS platforms or other relevant HR information system.
* Proficient in the use of IT and Microsoft programmes and iOS applications.
* Highly organised, detail\-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion.
* Desirable \- DMCC systems knowledge
* Desirable – KSA business visa and Iqama knowledge
* Strongly desirable \- Arabic speaker


**About You**
 The key competencies and behaviours we are looking for include:
   

  

* Excellent team working skills with an open, friendly, and supportive style.
* Ability to effectively, accurately, and concisely present and communicate in both written and verbal forms and be empathetic across different audiences and cultural sensitivities.
* Proven attention to detail
* Able to handle shifting demands.
* Responsive and helpful
* Self\-motivated and resourceful
* Loyal, displaying the highest levels of integrity and commitment.
* Flexible and adaptable in a dynamic company


**Benefits**
 If you are successful in this application we will invest in you, support, and train you to be successful, opening up a world of opportunities.
   

  

 Trivandi is committed to eliminating discrimination and encouraging diversity amongst our team. We aim to be truly representative of all sections of society, creating an environment where everyone feels respected and able to give of their best. We therefore warmly welcome applications from anyone who meets the criteria we’ve described.

data.jd_text:
**Job Location:** 
 Dubai, UAE
   

  

 Whiteshield is a global policy advisory and AI economics firm known for our ability to respond to global challenges rapidly and incisively. We use the most advanced tools and technology and combine them with our team of leading international experts to engage decision\-makers in tackling society's most significant challenges. We are recognized for our rapid decision support, innovation, data science algorithms and deep policy expertise. We are specialists in "connecting the dots" between policy, business and technology.
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced and driven
 **Digital Delivery Manager** 
 to join Whiteshield to become an integral part of our delivery organization. This role will be instrumental in establishing governance frameworks and driving excellence across our complex digital and policy initiatives. This Digital Delivery Manager should have very strong experience in project and program management, ideally with deep expertise in Agile methodologies and digital product delivery to complement our technical and policy teams.
   

  

 This is a role with a lot of responsibility and the potential to make a true impact \- on our delivery capability, within the business, and on government across the globe. We look for entrepreneurial people that want to make their mark on the world, and we empower and reward our staff accordingly. There is a lot of room for creativity and big ideas that shift the status quo. We are constantly delivering large new features and complex initiatives.
   

  

 You will report to our Principals and Partners working across all of our cross\-functional delivery teams, closely collaborating with product managers, developers, UI/UX designers, data scientists, business analysts, and QA teams.
   

  

**Who You Are**
 Entrepreneurial and ambitious, with your own perspective and ideas, and with an eagerness to contribute to the success of the organization's delivery excellence.
   

  

 Highly independent and self\-motivated, with strong leadership skills and a get\-things\-done attitude to deliver results.
   

  

 Passion for the public good and eagerness to make a societal impact with their work, ideally with a particular interest in economic development, workforce development, and education.
   

  

 Highly organized and eager to push the boundary on delivery excellence and really rethink traditional project management approaches.
   

  

 Eager to work in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment that challenges you to excel.
   

  

 Detail\-oriented with high standards for quality and governance.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**End\-to\-End Project Leadership:** 
 Lead end\-to\-end planning, execution, and closure of complex digital and policy projects from inception through delivery.
   

  

**PMO Governance:** 
 Establish and enforce PMO governance, delivery standards, and reporting frameworks across all projects to ensure consistency and quality.
   

  

**Cross\-Functional Coordination:** 
 Coordinate and drive cross\-functional delivery teams including product, data science, data engineering, AI and BI development to achieve project objectives.
   

  

**Stakeholder Interface:** 
 Act as the primary interface between business stakeholders, executive leadership, and technical teams to ensure alignment and transparency.
   

  

**Product Delivery Oversight:** 
 Govern the design, development, validation, and deployment of digital products to ensure they meet quality standards and business requirements.
   

  

**Analytics \& Reporting:** 
 Ensure effective visualization and consumption of insights through Live Jira dashboards and related analytics platforms for real\-time project visibility.
   

  

**Toolset Management:** 
 Manage project delivery using Jira, Confluence and Azure\-based toolsets, ensuring transparency, traceability, and control across all initiatives.
   

  

**Risk \& Issue Management:** 
 Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate project risks, issues, and dependencies to keep projects on track.
   

  

**Scope \& Schedule Control:** 
 Monitor and control scope, schedule, and benefits realization across concurrent initiatives to ensure successful outcomes.
   

  

**Quality Assurance:** 
 Ensure quality and consistency of deliverables through formal reviews and adherence to Whiteshield standards.
   

  

**Executive Reporting:** 
 Provide clear, concise, and regular status reporting to senior stakeholders and steering committees.
   

  

**Resource Optimization:** 
 Optimize resource planning, capacity management, and prioritization across multiple workstreams to maximize efficiency.
   

  

**Requirements**

**Head of Finance Transformation** 




  





**About the Opportunity** 




 A leading UAE\-based organisation is seeking an experienced Head of Finance Transformation to lead a large\-scale finance transformation programme. This is a strategic leadership role responsible for shaping and delivering a multi\-year transformation agenda that enhances financial performance, operational efficiency, governance, and business value across the organisation.
 



  





 The successful candidate will drive enterprise\-wide change, partner closely with executive leadership, and lead multiple transformation workstreams, ensuring successful adoption, measurable outcomes, and sustainable business benefits.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Define and execute the finance transformation vision, strategy, and roadmap aligned to organisational objectives.
* Lead large\-scale finance and business transformation initiatives across multiple functions and stakeholders.
* Drive process optimisation across key finance areas including financial close, controllership, treasury, reporting, planning, tax, and governance.
* Partner with executive leadership to establish priorities, secure buy\-in, and ensure successful programme delivery.
* Oversee transformation workstreams, ensuring delivery of business benefits, operational improvements, and performance targets.
* Lead organisational change management activities to support adoption and long\-term sustainability.
* Collaborate with technology and delivery teams to guide ERP and digital transformation initiatives, including SAP S/4HANA\-related programmes.
* Establish governance frameworks, KPIs, and benefit\-realisation mechanisms to track programme success.
* Build, mentor, and lead high\-performing transformation teams while fostering a culture of continuous improvement.
* Manage relationships with internal and external stakeholders, consultants, and delivery partners.



  





**Requirements** 



* 12\+ years of experience leading large\-scale finance, business, or enterprise transformation programmes.
* Demonstrated track record delivering measurable transformation outcomes across complex organisations.
* Strong experience driving enterprise change, business improvement, and executive stakeholder engagement.
* Expertise in finance transformation, including one or more of the following: SAP S/4HANA Finance programmes
* Finance process transformation
* Real estate, hospitality, or asset\-intensive industries
* Proven ability to lead cross\-functional teams and influence senior stakeholders.
* Strong commercial acumen with a focus on value creation and benefits realisation.
* Ability to quickly understand new industries, operating models, and technology environments.

* Professional certifications such as PMP, PgMP, SAP Activate, or Prosci.

* CA, CPA, CFA, MBA, or equivalent qualification is advantageous

 We are seeking a transformational leader who combines strategic vision with hands\-on delivery capability. You will be a proven change agent with the ability to align people, processes, and technology to achieve meaningful business outcomes. You will be comfortable operating at executive level while maintaining a strong focus on execution, stakeholder engagement, and value delivery.
 



  





**Why Apply?** 



* Opportunity to lead a high\-profile enterprise transformation programme.
* Significant exposure to executive leadership and strategic decision\-making.
* Ability to shape the future finance operating model of a leading organisation.

**About the Role**
 We are looking for a motivated People Administrator \& PRO to join our People team to support the day\-to\-day People operations and government relations activities for the business in Dubai and KSA, with a strong focus on DMCC processes and compliance.
   

  

 The role is responsible for coordinating employee lifecycle administration, including visa and immigration activities, maintaining employee records, supporting payroll inputs, and acting as the key liaison with DMCC and relevant UAE government authorities.
   

  

 This role requires strong organisational skills, attention to detail, excellent communication skills, and a proactive approach to employee support and compliance management.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will be highly energetic, professional and able to demonstrate integrity and discretion in all tasks. As this role involves handling sensitive personal and company data, you must be able to manage confidential information with the highest level of care and responsibility.
   

  

 To come on this journey with us, you’ll bring a great sense of humour, a positive and collaborative mindset, and the confidence to navigate a fast\-paced and sometimes ambiguous environment. You should be naturally resourceful, solutions\-driven, and comfortable taking initiative. Most importantly, you’ll enjoy a challenge and be excited by the opportunity to support and elevate the People function across all regions as we continue to grow.
   

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 At Trivandi all our roles are broad and flexible, but here’s a flavour of where you’ll focus your time:

* Track probation periods, visa expiry dates, passport renewals and other key employee milestones.
* Support payroll administration by preparing monthly payroll inputs including leave, allowances, deductions and employee changes.
* Maintain annual leave and attendance records.
* Respond to employee queries relating to HR policies, benefits, visas and company procedures.
* Support the implementation and continuous improvement of HR processes and systems.
* Assist with recruitment coordination including interview scheduling, candidate communication and onboarding administration.
* Ensure all HR practices are compliant with UAE labour law and company policies.


**PRO \& Government Relations Responsibilities** 
* Act as the main point of contact for DMCC and relevant UAE government authorities.
* Manage and process employment visas, labour cards, Emirates IDs, medicals and residency permits.
* Coordinate visa applications, renewals, cancellations and status changes for employees
* Maintain accurate tracking of all visa and immigration activities and ensure renewals are completed in advance of expiry dates.
* Ensure compliance with all DMCC regulations and UAE immigration requirements.
* Coordinate document attestation and notarisation processes where required.
* Support WPS and labour\-related administrative requirements.
* Keep up to date with changes to UAE labour law, immigration regulations and DMCC requirements and communicate impacts to the business.
* Support the KSA People team with KSA Business Visa applications and renewals, monitoring expiry dates and turnaround times. Ensure all documentation is complete and correct before employees visit the visa processing centre.


**Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
**Personal Skills and Experience**
 The key knowledge, experience, and qualifications we are looking for include:
 * 1–2 years of experience in Human Resources or People operations in Dubai, ideally within a professional services or fast\-paced environment.
* Strong administration skills developed within a professional setting.
* Experience with HRMS platforms or other relevant HR information system.
* Proficient in the use of IT and Microsoft programmes and iOS applications.
* Highly organised, detail\-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion.
* Desirable \- DMCC systems knowledge
* Desirable – KSA business visa and Iqama knowledge
* Strongly desirable \- Arabic speaker


**About You**
 The key competencies and behaviours we are looking for include:
 * Excellent team working skills with an open, friendly, and supportive style.
* Ability to effectively, accurately, and concisely present and communicate in both written and verbal forms and be empathetic across different audiences and cultural sensitivities.
* Proven attention to detail
* Able to handle shifting demands.
* Responsive and helpful
* Self\-motivated and resourceful
* Loyal, displaying the highest levels of integrity and commitment.
* Flexible and adaptable in a dynamic company


**Benefits**
 If you are successful in this application we will invest in you, support, and train you to be successful, opening up a world of opportunities.
   

  

 Trivandi is committed to eliminating discrimination and encouraging diversity amongst our team. We aim to be truly representative of all sections of society, creating an environment where everyone feels respected and able to give of their best. We therefore warmly welcome applications from anyone who meets the criteria we’ve described.

**About AstraZeneca**
 At AstraZeneca, we are proud of our ground\-breaking pipeline and continue to look for new ways to bring the best medicines to patients. We are building and fostering high\-performing collaborative teams across the organization to help us deliver on our ambition. There’s no better time to join our global, growing enterprise as we lead the way for patients, healthcare and broader society.
   

  

**AI Commercial Team (AIC)**
 The AI Commercial team, is part of the newly founded Enterprise AI team (EAI), delivering AI strategy and coordinated commercial progress and programs, in close collaboration with our business teams, and in partnership with our enterprise teams. We lead cross\-functional and commercial\-wide initiatives to deliver transformative commercial value and ensure we are at our best in delivering lifesaving medicines to patients.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 AI Commercial Business Leaders are the embedded “translators” between business functions and the AI Commercial organization, responsible for the success of AI programs. The role is strategically positioned in therapy areas, markets, and functions with the objectives to drive translation, adoption, and lifecycle management of AI solutions in the business.
   

  

 Key deliverables include translating business needs into well\-scoped AI use cases and ensure each solution delivers measurable business impact. This requires you to be bilingual in business/science and technology, enabling you to connect domain priorities with AI delivery teams. You will be responsible for owning the full lifecycle of AI solutions \- from ideation through delivery, adoption, and decommissioning \- and are accountable for driving real, sustained value and reuse.
   

  

 In this role, you will be responsible for building the bridge between business teams at a Region and Market level, and technical experts within the AIC and EAI function as well as key other Enterprise technology teams such as Commercial IT and Global Business Services. As part of this role, you will champion the key commercial AI programs in service of enhancing customer engagement, powered by actionable AI insights, delivered thought agentic platforms. In addition, you will partner on the delivery of AI capability building programs.
   

  

 To do this successfully, you will share geographic location with the respective Region team, have a seat at the Senior leader table for the Region, with connection further enhanced through dotted line reporting to the Region, while sitting on the AIC Leadership team reporting to VP AIC.
   

  

 The International region is the largest, most diverse and fastest growing region in AstraZeneca. It has over 28,000 employees across more than 75 markets, spanning many different cultures and languages. Areas it includes are: Middle East \& Africa, South America, Asia and Australasia.
   

  

**Responsibilities Include**
* Strategy and portfolio ownership of new AI Commercial programs for in partnership with the business teams.
* Single point of contact and responsible for engagement for AI Commercial capabilities programs for the Region, maintaining AI roadmaps aligned with business needs, developing business cases in partnership with the business, and promoting reuse principles.
* Translation of needs into AI use cases: Engaging with stakeholders to identify unmet needs and translating these into well\-defined AI use cases with clear metrics and requirements and a clear alignment with business strategy and AI30 focus areas.
* Delivery, scale, adoption and value tracking of AI initiatives: co\-leading solution delivery, overseeing lifecycle management including pilot shaping, deployment, adoption, and value realization, while ensuring appropriate evidence frameworks are applied.
* Change management and governance: Acting as change leaders embedding AI into operations, support AI literacy, and ensure data governance and compliance with standards and regulations, while collaborating with internal and external partners to drive commercial success at scale.
* Translating business needs into well\-scoped AI use cases and ensuring each solution delivers measurable business impact. This requires you to be bilingual in business and technology, enabling you to connect domain priorities with AI delivery teams. Owning the full lifecycle of AI solutions \- from ideation through delivery, adoption, and decommissioning.
* Spot and shape new enterprise initiatives by scanning internal/external trends and partnering with functional leaders.
* Track industry, market and innovation shifts to anticipate opportunities and risks.
* Lead change through structured stakeholder engagement, aligning perspectives and guiding teams through uncertainty.
* Define KPIs and monitoring to evaluate progress and pivot when needed.


**Typical Accountabilities Include**
* AI Strategy and portfolio ownership
+ Serve as the single business owner for AI solutions in their therapy area, market, or function.
+ Maintain and sequence a clear AI roadmap aligned to business, medical, access, and R\&D priorities.
+ Develop business cases and value narratives to support prioritization decisions.
+ Embed reuse principles ("build or buy once, scale to many") when defining and shaping demand.

* Translation of needs into AI use cases
+ Engage business leaders and cross\-functional teams to surface unmet needs and decision points where AI can drive new outcomes.
+ Translate needs into well\-scoped AI use cases with clear problem statements, success metrics, data requirements, and risk tiering.
+ Act as bilingual translators connecting business priorities, scientific context, and technology capabilities.

* Delivery, scale, adoption and value tracking
+ Co\-lead delivery with enterprise AI teams to ensure solutions fit real workflows and local systems.
+ Own the full AI Program lifecycle, including:
+ Pilot shaping
+ Scaled deployment
+ Local adoption and change readiness
+ Tracking of adoption KPIs
+ Outcome and ROI realization
+ Remediation or decommissioning when needed
+ Ensure correct evidence frameworks are applied to measure value.

* Change management and ways of working
+ Act as change leaders for AI, embedding new practices into day\-to\-day operations – avoiding one\-off pilots that don’t inform or lead to a scaled solution
+ Identify required process and role shifts and work with functional leaders to implement them, in order to advance adoption of AI solutions.
+ Support AI literacy and upskilling by partnering with the AITO team and HR on targeted learnings.

* Data, governance and compliance point of contact for the International region
+ Partner with Enterprise Demand Excellence (EDE) and AITT to ensure data used in solutions is AI\-ready and compliant with enterprise standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, AI act, SAMd).
+ Ensure each AI use case follows the enterprise governance framework, including:
+ Registry\-before\-scale
+ Model and data cards
+ Ongoing monitoring
+ Human\-in\-the\-loop oversight when required
+ Ensure AI solutions align with quality, legal, compliance, PV and safety requirements, and local codes.

* Deliver Partnership and ecosystem
* Clear co\-development of AI programs and delivery plans, ensuring business maintains sponsorship and ownership from inception to delivery and scaling.
* Develop clear and deep delivery relationships with Commercial AI and Global Business Services teams. Drive focus across business and enterprise teams to establish clear and mutually aligned remits for coordinated delivery of AI programs
* Build a culture of coordinated delivery with pride, shared purpose and celebration. Supporting a culture of co\-delivery and ability to raise and address concerns in a psychologically safe environment.
* Integration with enterprise AI organization
* Act as the primary interface between your business area and CAI Capability teams (Customer and Patient Engagement, Commercial DS\&AI) and Enterprise AI teams (i.e., AISI, AITC, AICA, AIEI, AITT, EDE), ensuring clarity on ownership, priorities and hand\-offs.


**Essential For The Role**
* Substantial proven experience leading transformation programs in commercial pharma.
* Demonstrated commercial and scientific domain experience reflecting a deep understanding of the needs of the business function and Region you are responsible for.
* Strong analytical and communication skills at all levels of the organization and the ability to operate successfully in highly matrixed organizations

data.jd_text:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission\-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting\-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
   

  

 Your impact
   

  

 At Jacobs, we push the limits of what’s possible to make the world smarter, more connected and more sustainable. In our transport work, that means designing innovative solutions to move people and goods safely and efficiently across the globe. From rail systems mobilising accessible transit, to ports linking land and sea – when it comes to connecting the people and places of tomorrow, the future of transport depends on us.
   

  

 Bring your curiosity, talent for multi\-tasking, and extreme attention to detail, and we’ll help you grow, pursue and fulfill what drives you – so we can make big impacts on the world, together
   

  

 We are seeking a
 **Principal Consultant / Engagement Manager** 
 to join our Strategic Advisory team in the Middle East. This is a leadership role focused on delivering strategic and advisory engagements across a broad range of government priorities, including economic development, sector development, infrastructure, investment initiatives, policy implementation, and national transformation programs.
   

  

 The successful candidate will lead complex consulting engagements, manage multidisciplinary teams, build trusted client relationships, and support the continued growth of our advisory business across the region.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 As a
 **Principal Consultant / Engagement Manager** 
 , you will play a pivotal role in delivering high\-impact advisory services while supporting the growth of the practice.
   

  

 Your responsibilities will include
   

  

* Leading multidisciplinary teams in the delivery of complex advisory engagements for government, public sector, and private sector clients.
* Advising ministries, government agencies, regulators, public authorities, government\-owned entities, investors, and private sector organizations on strategic priorities, sector development, policy implementation, investment initiatives, and transformational programs.
* Managing the development of strategies, business cases, policy assessments, implementation plans, economic analyses, sector studies, and other advisory deliverables tailored to client needs.
* Supporting clients in addressing complex economic, social, infrastructure, and development challenges through evidence\-based analysis and practical recommendations.
* Conducting research, benchmarking, market assessments, and quantitative and qualitative analyses to support strategic decision\-making.
* Managing complex stakeholder environments and engaging effectively with senior government officials, executives, regulators, investors, and private sector leaders.
* Leading project delivery to ensure technical excellence, commercial performance, quality outcomes, and client satisfaction.
* Managing project budgets, schedules, resources, risks, and contractual obligations.
* Supporting major national initiatives, sector development programs, and strategic priorities across the Middle East.
* Supporting business development activities, including opportunity identification, client engagement, and proposal preparation.
* Building and maintaining strong client relationships and acting as a trusted advisor to senior decision\-makers.
* Supporting collaboration across Jacobs' global advisory network to leverage best practices and technical expertise.


 Here's what you'll need
   

  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Economics, Business Administration, Public Policy, Engineering, Finance, or a related discipline.
* 8\+ years of professional experience in management consulting, government advisory, public sector advisory, strategy consulting, economic development, infrastructure advisory, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex consulting engagements and multidisciplinary project teams.
* Experience delivering advisory projects for government entities, public authorities, regulators, government\-owned organizations, investors, or private sector clients.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, report writing, and presentation skills.
* Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills with the ability to influence senior decision\-makers.
* Strong project management capabilities with experience managing budgets, schedules, and client relationships.
* Proven ability to support business development activities and contribute to winning new work.


 Ideally, Here's What You'll Also Have
   

  

* Experience supporting national transformation initiatives, Vision programs, or government development agendas within the GCC and broader Middle East region.

data.jd_text:
Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drive everything we do. The Middle East markets (UAE and Kuwait) are one of our most dynamic and competitive markets. Functions include commercial, operations, and marketing, and teams in the Middle East partner closely with global functions such as product, technology, and consumer to deliver results for our customers.
   

  

 This role sits within Operations and leads all things Rider Experience. A large and impactful scope that includes Rider community management, Rider communications, several aspects of Rider Performance, Rider Support, and Rider Onboarding. The role entails building, improving, and implementing processes across the areas above, tracking and managing efficiency and effectiveness of how we are performing across a variety of metrics, and finally ensuring that we are able to deliver excellent support to riders across the region.
   

  

**The Role**
 Operating at scale in a hyper\-competitive, hyper\-growth environment is no easy feat. As such, you'll be faced with some of the most exciting problems across the food tech space. Reporting to the Director of Operations, Middle East, you’ll have a key role in ensuring the success of the logistics network in our Middle East markets. This centers around ensuring that we always have a fleet of highly engaged, highly satisfied, and highly performing riders on our network. Working with stakeholders within Ops to find the right approach through levers like communications, education modules, and rider events. This role is regional, and will be required to build world\-class frameworks and systems that are both effective and scalable. The objective is straightforward: build the best systems to ensure riders are able to deliver the best experience for our customers and merchants.
   

  

 You’ll work closely with other members of the Middle East rider operations teams, as well as wider teams within HQ Ops, Product, and Tech to ensure the best possible outcomes for our riders, restaurants, and customers.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
 Here’s what your day\-to\-day might look like:
   

  

* Managing a large team that owns and runs several processes across the scope of the team
* Building effective, scalable, and efficient frameworks and systems that can be centralized to manage and track several key metrics across our network
* Make recommendations on how to allocate our resources to ensure the best possible outcomes, for instance, managing rider churn to optimal levels to ensure best\-in\-class service levels
* Ensuring the quality and engagement of riders newly onboarded on our network is conducive to our strategy of having best\-in\-class service levels
* Track our key metrics, look for unusual trends in our data, and uncover root causes to ensure that we preserve the health of the network.
* Work alongside other members of the Middle East Rider Operations team to ensure that we operate to budget
* Provide regular, relevant, concise updates on rider experience to senior business stakeholders.


**What You'll Need To Thrive**
 Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:
   

  

* A high standard of university\-level education
* 8\+ years of experience in program management, consulting, banking, engineering, or a high\-growth start\-up
* Excellent problem\-solving skills – experience solving tough, complex problems
* An ownership mindset that means you know what is happening in your area of responsibility
* Experience managing a multi\-functional team
* Experience building scalable processes, tools, and structured change methodologies, and therefore enjoying working in a process\-driven environment
* Strong analytical mindset and comfortable with large data sets
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
* Comfortable handling multiple workstreams at the same time, working both individually and as part of a team


**Why Join Us?**
 At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real\-world problems in a three\-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.
   

  

 We’re Food Lovers, Problem Solvers, Community Builders, And More, Brought Together By a Shared Drive To Make Things Better. Working Here, You Can Expect To

 environment.

 High standards, collaboration, flexible working, and continuous learning.
   

  

 We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3\-4 stages. Find more about how we hire

**Our Global Structure**
 Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
   

  

**Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion**
 At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

data.jd_text:
The Planning Manager will lead the end\-to\-end planning function for real estate development projects from concept through handover. This role is responsible for developing, monitoring, and controlling master programmes across design, authority approvals, procurement, construction, and handover stages, ensuring alignment with development strategy, timelines, and business objectives.
 



 The role requires strong coordination with Design, Procurement, Commercial, and Construction teams, as well as consultants, contractors, and authorities to drive schedule certainty and proactive risk mitigation.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**Programme Development \& Control** 




 · Develop and maintain integrated master programmes covering design, approvals, procurement, construction, and handover stages.
 



 · Prepare pre\-tender and post\-tender programmes and review contractor schedules for alignment with development milestones.
 



 · Ensure approved baselines are established and maintained across all project stages.
 



 · Support recovery planning and scenario planning when required.
 



**Design \& Pre\-Construction Planning** 




 · Lead planning inputs during design development to ensure programme feasibility and proper sequencing.
 



 · Interpret design, procurement, and construction sequences into practical and achievable schedules.
 



 · Incorporate authority approval processes and statutory timelines into project programmes.
 



**Monitoring, Reporting \& Analysis** 




 · Monitor project progress against baseline programmes and identify risks or delays.
 



 · Conduct critical path and delay analysis with mitigation strategies.
 



 · Analyze project data to forecast potential impacts on timelines and resources.
 



 · Prepare progress reports, dashboards, and schedule presentations for senior management.
 



**Stakeholder Coordination \& Reviews** 




 · Coordinate with Design, Commercial, Procurement, and Construction teams to ensure programme alignment.
 



 · Conduct regular programme review meetings with consultants and contractors.
 



 · Ensure alignment of consultant and contractor programmes with development objectives.
 



**Planning Standards \& Governance** 




 · Ensure consistent planning standards, methodologies, and reporting formats across projects.
 



 · Maintain planning documentation and records in line with company and project requirements.
 



 Requirements
 



**Qualifications \& Experience:** 



* Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering or related discipline.
* 7–10 years of experience in project planning within real estate development, consultancy, or contractor environment, with exposure to developer\-side planning.
* Strong understanding of UAE authority approval processes and development timelines.
* Demonstrated experience managing multiple projects and complex schedules simultaneously.
* Proven ability to interpret design, procurement, and construction sequences into practical programmes.
* High attention to detail with strong organizational capability.

CNS (Computer Network Systems) is a technology company in the middle\-east \& has over 30 years of successful achievements and long\-term partnerships with distinct customers across the region.

 We are a Part of the Ghobash Group of Companies, CNS spread across the region with offices in Abu Dhabi, Dubai, Oman, and Kuwait providing a holistic approach that covers all aspects of information communication technology system integration, consultancy, operation, managed services, and IT outsourcing.
   

  

 CNS also has state\-of\-the\-art network operation centers in Abu Dhabi and Dubai that develop in\-house software and applications providing end\-to\-end solutions to our customers and partners.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The Project Manager is responsible for managing the successful delivery of technology and systems integration projects across the project lifecycle, ensuring alignment with approved scope, schedule, budget, quality standards, and customer expectations.
   

  

 Reporting directly to the Head of PMO, the Project Manager will work closely with Senior Project Managers, technical teams, vendors, and client stakeholders to coordinate project execution activities, monitor delivery progress, manage operational risks, and maintain project governance documentation.
   

  

 The role requires strong coordination, communication, and organizational skills to manage day\-to\-day delivery activities across multiple concurrent projects while supporting governance and reporting requirements defined by the PMO.
   

  

**Duties \& Responsibilities**
**Project Delivery \& Coordination**
* Manage the day\-to\-day execution of assigned technology and systems integration projects.
* Develop and maintain project schedules, task trackers, action logs, RAID logs, dependency trackers, and change request records.
* Monitor project progress against approved baselines and escalate deviations, risks, and delays in a timely manner.
* Coordinate project activities across technical teams, vendors, subcontractors, procurement, and client stakeholders.
* Track project deliverables, milestones, approvals, and operational dependencies to ensure timely execution.
* Support project planning activities including resource coordination, effort tracking, and timeline management.
* Coordinate UAT activities, deployment readiness, transition to support, and project closure activities.


**Stakeholder \& Client Management**
* Maintain effective communication with project stakeholders, technical teams, and client representatives.
* Participate in project governance meetings, progress reviews, operational discussions, and status reporting sessions.
* Ensure project actions, decisions, risks, and dependencies are properly documented and communicated.
* Support the management of client expectations through transparent reporting and proactive coordination.
* Escalate project issues and operational blockers to senior management and PMO leadership when required.


**Vendor \& Delivery Management**
* Coordinate with vendors and subcontractors to ensure delivery commitments and timelines are achieved.
* Monitor vendor deliverables and support tracking of contractual milestones and acceptance activities.
* Follow up on pending actions, technical dependencies, and issue resolution activities with delivery partners.
* Assist in coordinating change requests, variation discussions, and delivery impact assessments.


**Governance \& Reporting**
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date project governance documentation including:
+ Project plans
+ RAID logs
+ Status reports
+ Change logs
+ Action trackers
+ Meeting minutes

* Prepare weekly and monthly project status reports for PMO and management review.
* Support PMO governance processes, reporting standards, and compliance requirements.
* Ensure project documentation is centrally maintained and aligned with PMO standards.


**PMO \& Process Support**
* Support PMO initiatives related to process standardization, governance improvements, and reporting optimization.
* Contribute to the adoption of project management tools, reporting templates, and PMO best practices.
* Assist in maintaining project data quality and portfolio reporting accuracy within PMO systems and reporting platforms.
* Participate in continuous improvement initiatives related to project delivery and operational efficiency.


**Qualifications**
**Education**
**Minimum:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related discipline.


**Desired:**
* PMP certification or equivalent project management certification.
* Agile, PRINCE2, or Scrum certifications are an advantage.


**Experience**
**Minimum:**
* 5\+ years of project management or project coordination experience within technology or systems integration environments.
* Experience managing client\-facing technology projects and coordinating cross\-functional teams.
* Experience maintaining project schedules, RAID logs, and governance reporting.
* Exposure to vendor coordination and multi\-stakeholder project environments.


**Desired:**
* Experience within UAE/GCC government or enterprise environments.
* Experience working within a PMO governance structure.
* Familiarity with project portfolio management and reporting tools.
* Experience supporting systems integration, infrastructure, software, or digital transformation projects.


**Skills \& Abilities**
**Minimum:**
* Good understanding of project management methodologies including Waterfall and Agile delivery approaches.
* Strong coordination and organizational skills.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in English; Arabic is an advantage.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and concurrent project activities.
* Strong follow\-up, documentation, and reporting capability.
* Good stakeholder communication and escalation management skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively across technical and business teams.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Project, Excel, PowerPoint, and project reporting tools.


**Desired:**
* Proficiency in EPMO/PPM tooling platforms and ability to drive adoption across teams.
* Experience developing PMO dashboards, KPI frameworks, and portfolio reporting.
* Strong understanding of commercial and contractual terms in systems integration engagements.
* Experience managing stakeholders at C\-suite and board level.
* Change management and organizational transformation experience.


**Additional Information**
*Compliance with policies and procedures based on the ISO standards adopted by CNS.*

**Job Description**
 Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented
 **Project Controls Manager** 
 to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will lead and manage all project controls functions for a major railway project, including planning and scheduling, cost control, risk management, and performance reporting, ensuring alignment with project objectives, contractual requirements, and industry best practices. You will work closely with multidisciplinary teams and key stakeholders to drive schedule integrity, cost efficiency, and effective project governance across the project lifecycle.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Provide strategic leadership and oversight for project controls functions including planning, scheduling, cost management, progress tracking, risk mitigation, change control, and performance reporting across infrastructure programs.
* Provide guidance, direction, and specialized assistance to planning \& risk staff, interface with clients, and attend regular meetings.
* Develop, implement, and maintain project controls processes, procedures, systems, plans and tools and monitor compliance.
* Arrange project controls workshops/ meetings to discuss and assist contractors/consultants to close their project control issues.
* Develop a Master Schedule integrating multiple packages considering their interdependencies to identify and reflect the impact of one schedule/project on others.
* Review and convey PMC’s and Engineer’s consent to the Contractors’ Baseline schedule of works in line with Contract conditions, and using Parsons Recommended Practices.
* Validation of compatibility of project resources for timely completion of the project.
* Strong foreseeability to identify the potential risks/conflicts, and document them in the Project Risk Register.
* Evaluate \& verify the planning and scheduling information from the updated / progress schedules. Identify the potential areas of delay/slippage, highlight the critical events \& suggest mitigation measures / corrective actions / robust recovery plan.
* Exercise “What if” analysis to assess the time impact of each change, variation, and potential event at an early stage and provide alternative courses of action \& advice before issuing instructions to contractors.
* Prepare regular progress reports / monthly reports with program analysis and recommendations, addressing program issues to ensure timely project completion, and preparing presentations regarding the work's progress concerning interim and major milestones.
* Evaluate claims including Extension of Time (EoT) and Disruption claims using recognized delay analysis techniques such as Time Impact Analysis and Window Analysis, with the ability to assess concurrent delays.
* Discuss, coordinate, and resolve the planning and scheduling problems with the PMC, the Contractor and the Employer.
* Coordination with the Client to finalize the contractor’s programs, reports, and claims.
* Actively participate in project meetings (e.g., kickoff, technical, coordination, progress reviews) and prepare concise, actionable minutes of meeting (MoM).
* Preparation of Trackers / Logs to monitor critical issues during the Design and Construction stages of the Project.
* Agree on the progress measurement system (PMS) and key indicators with the consultants/contractors during the project for monitoring purposes.
* Ability to communicate clearly conduct presentations to management and interface effectively with a diverse group of professionals. Provide reasoned \& analytic response to the contractor notices and detailed particulars using programming data, sound construction practices, and contractual provisions.
* Maintain organized contemporary records to support claims analysis and contract administration processes.
* Issue formal delay notices and performance alerts when contractor progress is deficient or non\-compliant with schedule obligations
* Be able to manage a team of one or more planning engineers, providing them with technical and leadership skills.
* Lead structured risk workshops with both client and contractor teams to identify and manage project risks and opportunities.
* Champion the adoption of automation and digitalization within the project controls function to improve reporting accuracy and reduce manual workloads.


**What Required Skills You'll Bring**
* Bachelor's degree in civil engineering or construction management from a recognized institution.
* Minimum 15\+ years of experience in project controls, preferably on large\-scale construction or infrastructure projects, including prior experience on metro rail projects, with at least 3 years of experience in the UAE.
* Proficiency in Primavera P6, Primavera Risk Analysis, other Risk software and Power BI.


**What Desired Skills You'll Bring**
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Thorough knowledge of industry best practices and regulations.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment.

Who We Are
   

  

 Fueled by passion, KAYALI was founded in 2018 by beauty mogul and fragrance fanatic, Mona Kattan. Translating to ‘my imagination' in Arabic, KAYALI provides a modern fragrance experience inspired by Mona's rich Middle Eastern heritage and the art of layering scents to help you create your mood; where sharing scents is a ritual and smelling good is both an act of goodwill and self\-love. Mona collaborates with some of the world's most renowned perfumers and sources the finest ingredients to create unique juices that are infinitely memorable, long\-lasting, and cruelty\-free. A trusted partner for millions of customers, Ecolab is a global sustainability leader offering water, hygiene and infection prevention solutions and services that protect people and the resources vital to life. The Middle East and Africa Market is one of our highest\-potential growth markets, and we are investing to accelerate that growth through Enterprise AI, data, and digital innovation.
   

  

 As our
 **Enterprise Ai \- Business Engagement Leader** 
**– Middle East Africa** 
 , you will be at the centre of the MEA market leadership team and serve as the senior link between Ecolab’s
 **Enterprise AI** 
 organisation and the Divisions, Functions, and country leaders driving growth across the region. You will fuel the MEA growth agenda with technology and AI\-enabled business outcomes — accountable for the delivery of solutions, from idea to value capture.
   

  

**What’s In It For You**
* Lead the Enterprise AI agenda for one of Ecolab’s highest\-potential international markets
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of AI, data, and digital solutions that directly accelerate top\-line and margin growth across MEA
* Partner with senior Market, Division, and Function leaders as a trusted commercially aware technology advisor
* Shape technology strategy, investment prioritisation, and value capture inside a $16B global sustainability leader
* Influence Enterprise\-wide AI and digital strategy while owning local growth outcomes
* Build and develop a high\-performing team of business process analysts and digital talent across the region
* Competitive total rewards, comprehensive benefits, and global career mobility within Ecolab


**What You Will Do**
**Strategic Partnership \& Growth Alignment** 
 — Build strong partnering relationships with MEA business and function leaders to understand their growth ambitions, commercial priorities, and operational challenges. Align Ecolab’s Technology strategy with the MEA market growth strategy, leveraging technology, AI, and analytics to unlock new revenue, expand share, and improve customer outcomes. Act as a trusted advisor and advocate for the business divisions and functions.
   

  

**Solutions Accountability** 
 — Own the delivery of value stream solutions for MEA — from demand intake and business case, through design, build, deployment, adoption, and value realisation. Hold global delivery teams, partners, and local stakeholders to outcomes, schedule, cost, and quality; remove blockers; and ensure committed business value is captured and reported.
   

  

**IT Project Portfolio Management** 
 — Bring visibility and prioritisation to the portfolio of Enterprise AI and digital projects supporting MEA business and function activities. In line with global governance processes, establish project priorities, secure resource availability, and monitor progress to ensure timely and successful delivery. Manage stakeholder expectations and resolve issues and risks proactively.
   

  

**Digital \& AI Investment Management** 
 — Work with MEA business leaders to determine Enterprise AI and digital investment levels based on growth opportunity, organisational priorities, and budgetary considerations. Provide recommendations on technology investments, cost optimisation, and resource allocation to maximise commercial value and ROI.
   

  

**Business Relationship Management** 
 — Serve as the primary point of contact for MEA business and function leaders on Enterprise AI, data, and digital topics. Drive effective communication, manage expectations, and address systemic issues, escalations, and enhancement requests related to applications, infrastructure, and digital services.
   

  

**Service Delivery Assurance** 
 — Oversee Enterprise AI and Digital service and support processes for the MEA business. Proactively track service levels, drive process improvement, and act as the escalation point for service topics that impact the growth agenda.
   

  

**Demand Intake \& Prioritisation** 
 — Filter and prioritise MEA project requests before the PMO intake process starts. Verify budget exists in the business or Enterprise Ai plan, and confirm business resource readiness. Keep Enterprise AI resources focused on the highest\-value, growth\-aligned work.
   

  

**Governance, Security \& Architecture** 
 — Ensure 100% Security and Enterprise Architecture sign\-off on MEA projects. Drive adoption of standard, secure enterprise platforms that unlock data and AI opportunities at scale and protect the business.
   

  

**Talent \& Team Leadership** 
 — Lead, coach, and develop market\-aligned business process analysts and digital talent. Drive a strong Enterprise AI culture across the MEA team in line with the Ecolab leadership model, managing by influence across the broader Enterprise AI organisation.
   

  

**Position Details**
* Location: Middle East and Africa region (primary hub Dubai)
* Travel: Regional travel across Middle East and Africa; periodic international travel for Enterprise AI and Markets leadership engagements
* Reporting line: Solid\-line to the Global Markets Business Engagement Leader, with close alignment to the MEA Market Head as a member of the MEA market leadership team
* Work model: Full\-time, hybrid


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in a technical, business, or related field
* 10\+ years of relevant experience in IT, Digital, AI/Data, Business Analysis, Programme Management, or a similar leadership role
* Demonstrated accountability and track record for delivery of major technology or digital programmes in a multi\-country, matrixed environment
* Proven business and commercial acumen — experience of partnering with senior business and function leaders, building business cases, and translating technology strategy into measurable growth outcomes
* Experience managing third\-party technology service providers and global delivery partners against outcome\-based commitments
* Strong written and spoken English


**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience leading AI, data, and analytics initiatives that have delivered measurable commercial growth
* Experience in a global manufacturing, B2B services, or industrial environment
* Familiarity with enterprise platforms such as SAP/ERP, CRM, data and analytics, cloud, and security technologies
* Knowledge of Ecolab’s industries — Institutional, Industrial, Healthcare, Life Sciences, Pest Elimination — is a plus
* Additional regional languages (Arabic, French) a plus
* Master’s degree or equivalent (MBA, MSc) a plus


**Key Skills \& Leadership Behaviours**

* Growth mindset — relentless focus on unlocking new revenue, market share, and productivity through Enterprise AI and digital
* Ownership — drives delivery from idea to adoption to value capture, with no hand\-off gaps
* Leadership presence to motivate and develop diverse, multi\-country teams
* Manage by influence — collaborates across global Enterprise AI groups to develop talent and drive results
* Focus and decisiveness — enables action and progress even when faced with ambiguity
* Executive communication — strong stakeholder management at C\-suite and Market leadership level

 Enterprise AI is the technology and intelligence engine behind Ecolab’s global growth — delivering the AI, data, platforms, and digital solutions that help our customers and our 48,000 associates operate cleaner, safer, and more sustainably in more than 170 countries. We combine the agility of an AI\-first organisation with the scale and stability of a Fortune 500 enterprise, partnering closely with every Ecolab Division, Market, and Function to turn data and technology into measurable commercial growth.
   

  

 Join us, and help shape what comes next — for Ecolab, for our customers, and for the planet.
   

  

**Our Commitment to a Culture of Inclusion \& Belonging**

We will recruit, hire, promote, transfer and provide opportunities for advancement based on individual qualifications and job performance in all matters affecting employment, compensation, benefits, working conditions, and opportunities for advancement. ***We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem\-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.***
**About The Role**
 As a Program Manager within the Product organisation, you will be the bridge that brings colleagues together to deliver complex, cross\-functional technical initiatives — often with tight deadlines and multi\-layered dependencies. You will build relationships grounded in trust and integrity across the organisation and with third\-party partners, enabling you to break through collaboration barriers, resolve conflicts, and manage risks effectively.
   

  

 This role sits within the Rides Product team, which leads product strategy and delivery for the Rides vertical to simplify mobility for customers.
