data.jd_text:
At Lummus Technology, innovation thrives, and excellence is a shared pursuit. When you join Lummus, you are empowered to make an impact and be part of a dynamic team that celebrates creativity, encourages professional development, and fosters collaboration.
   

  

 From our technology portfolio to our global workforce, Lummus is growing at a rapid pace, and we hope that you will grow with us during this exciting time.
   

  

 Lummus Consultants International (LCI) is an autonomous business within Lummus Technology that provides technical, environmental \& social and management consulting services worldwide. We work primarily in the energy industry, with a depth of expertise in power generation, oil \& gas, refining and petrochemicals. We maintain a very strong presence in the international technical due diligence markets to support the global financial industry. LCI has a far\-reaching organization with offices in the United States, UK, the Middle East and Asia.
   

  

 Lummus Consultants is looking for a Business Development Director to grow the company into the area of technical and management consulting in the energy industry – offshore and onshore oil \& gas, LNG, pipelines, power generation and transmission, as well as refining and petrochemicals. This role will be expected to help grow the consulting practice area in the fields of oil\& Gas, power delivery and decarbonization and will primarily entail growing relationships with the financial community and project developers. Assignments require a high level of experience and ability to focus quickly on important issues.
   

  

 The individual we are seeking must be comfortable and confident to work in a seller/doer organization structure.
   

  

**Position**
 The Business Development Director will be expected to grow and lead a new consulting practice area in the fields of Oil \& Gas, power delivery and decarbonization. The group VP and the Leadership Team should have contacts and skills to help him achieve this goal. An international focus is expected. Areas of skill and knowledge should include knowledge of project financing, capex benchmarking analysis, O\&M practices and costs, M\&A support, due diligence and strategy development. The candidate will be expected to lead and participate in advisory assignments, conduct business development, and manage his/her practice business area and interface with Lummus Consultants’ senior management. Additional business areas may be identified based upon the candidate’s personal history and strengths and interests.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities/Accountabilities**
* Grow Lummus Consultants’ business – in cooperation with the existing business heads. His growth strategy should be heavily focused on technical solutions but with a broad business perspective beyond traditional due diligence assignments.
* Develop a business plan to capitalize on existing talents and resources within Lummus Consultants and Lummus Technology; the candidate’s strengths; and market opportunities.
* Grow name recognition of Lummus Consultants in all Energy industry segments (with assistance from the Lummus Communication team and other internal resources).
* Carry out business development, marketing, and proposal preparation efforts and lead Key Account Management teams efforts.
* Lead or participate in consulting project work.
* Prepare clear and concise written reports on assignments, develop conclusions and present clear and precise written and verbal results to clients.
* Expand the Lummus Consulting practice area (globally), consistent with the business plan – identify gaps in skills and potential recruits.
* Achieve objectives with minimal oversight.
* Management of the P\&L forecast by close collaboration with his supervisor and finance.
* Report to Senior Director of Lummus Consultants in Dubai office.


**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities Required**
* Strong leadership abilities and excellent interpersonal skills
* Strong communicator with excellent written and oral communication skills
* Must have a high degree of self\-motivation and energy
* Must have proven ability to manage business forecasting, short and long term projection
* Capability of earning respect from the team and capable of influencing others without authority
* Excellent professional image/presentation
* Knowledge of many cultures/international style
* Strong commercial savvy and negotiating skills
* Interest in being knowledgeable in all services offerings in Lummus Consultants portfolio
* Ability to work well with finance partners.
* Must have a strong balance of technical and commercial capabilities.


**Basic Qualifications**
* A degree\-educated Engineer; MBA is a plus but not required.
* The candidate should have at least 20 years relevant professional experience.
* Prior experience with an owner/operator or major engineering company and/or consultancy.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including ability to write clear and concise reports in English.
* The candidate should have strong interpersonal skills and be comfortable conversing with clients and senior management
* Demonstrated management and project management skills


**Office Location and Travel:**
* Dubai office. Relocation is not being offered.
* Job\-related travel (business trips usually requiring less than a two\-week duration; often just one or two days) which includes international travel to financial institutions in London, is an important part of the work. Time away from the office may average 10 to 30 percent of work hours.


 Lummus Technology is the global leader in developing technology solutions that make modern life possible and focus on a more sustainable, low carbon future. We license process technologies in clean fuels, renewables, petrochemicals, polymers, gas processing and supply lifecycle services, catalysts, proprietary equipment and digitalization to customers worldwide.

**About Techne Agency** 




 Techne is a boutique marketing agency operating at the intersection of brand, content and performance. We specialise in social media, content production, influencer marketing, paid media and SEO, delivering integrated strategies across the full customer journey.
 



 We work with premium and luxury brands across hospitality, fashion, beauty and lifestyle, supporting both brand\-building and performance\-driven marketing with a strong track record across the UK, UAE and Europe. Our teams are based across London and Dubai, working with clients on both sides — European, US and UAE markets.
 



  





**The Role** 




 We're looking for an experienced Account Manager to own social media, content and influencer delivery across a portfolio of premium client accounts based in the UAE and wider GCC.
 



 This is a hands\-on, client\-facing role with real account ownership. You will lead day\-to\-day social media and content delivery, manage influencer campaigns end to end, and play an active role in content production including shoots and on\-site activity. You will work closely with the Social \& Influencer Lead and the Director of Client Services, bringing structure, initiative and high standards to how accounts are run. This is not a junior support role. You will be expected to manage clients independently, lead influencer campaigns from brief to delivery, and keep multiple projects moving simultaneously without dropping the ball.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Client \& Account Management** 



* Own day\-to\-day client communication across a portfolio of social media accounts \& influencer marketing campaigns.
* Build and manage content calendars across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and LinkedIn
* Write captions and post copy aligned to brand tone of voice and guidelines
* Manage internal review processes, client approvals and content amends
* Ensure all content is delivered on time, to brief and to the standard clients expect
* Proactively flag risks, delays or scope creep in collaboration with AD.



  





  





**Influencer Marketing** 



* Lead influencer campaigns end to end — from casting and outreach to contracting, briefing and delivery
* Build and maintain a database of creators across relevant markets and categories
* Manage influencer relationships, deliverables and timelines autonomously
* Ensure all content aligns with brand guidelines and campaign objectives before going live
* Track and report on influencer performance and surface insights to the team and clients using our influencer marketing tools



  





**Content Production \& Shoots** 



* Support content production planning including production decks, schedules and shot lists
* Attend shoots when required and assist with on\-the\-ground direction and capture
* Manage asset delivery post\-shoot including organisation, selects and client submissions
* Coordinate with videographers, photographers and in house teams as needed



  





**Content Scheduling \& Publishing** 



* Oversee scheduling and publishing of approved content using social media management tools
* Quality\-check all posts before publishing — formatting, tagging, captions, links
* Ensure accuracy and consistency across platforms and campaigns



  





**Reporting \& Performance** 



* Track core performance metrics including engagement, reach and content performance
* Contribute observations and recommendations to reporting — not just raw data
* Support monthly and quarterly reporting cycles with client\-ready insights



  





**Community Management** 



* Monitor comments, messages and mentions across managed accounts
* Coordinate responses in line with brand tone of voice and agreed guidelines
* Escalate sensitive issues or enquiries appropriately and promptly



  





  





**What We're Looking For** 




**Essential:** 



* 4\-5\+ years of experience in social media and influencer marketing, ideally within an agency environment
* Proven track record of managing client accounts independently — owning the relationship, not just the tasks
* Strong end\-to\-end understanding of influencer marketing — casting, contracting, briefing and delivery
* Hands\-on experience with content creation and short\-form video
* Confident managing multiple accounts and deadlines simultaneously
* Comfortable working directly with clients and managing feedback professionally
* Based in Dubai or willing to relocate — this role requires a UAE presence
* Familiarity with the GCC market and regional audience behaviour



  





**Nice to Have:** 



* Experience working with luxury, hospitality or lifestyle brands
* Experience with influencer management platforms such as Lefty
* Familiarity with AI tools and efficient workflows for content production
* Arabic language skills or experience working across GCC markets
* Willingness to travel across the UAE and internationally for shoots when required



  




**Why Join Techne** 
* Work on high\-profile, international hospitality and luxury clients.
* Be hands\-on with real content production, not just scheduling.
* Learn directly from senior leadership in a growing agency.
* Travel opportunities in GCC, UK and Europe for client projects.
* Gain exposure to social strategy, influencer marketing and content production.
* Remote\-first setup with meaningful on\-site work where it adds value.



  





**A Note for this Role** 




 This role is central to how we build out the Dubai team and deliver exceptional work for our growing UAE and GCC portfolio. We’re looking for someone who can take real ownership of client accounts from day one. You'll be working closely with the Social \& Influencer Lead and the broader team across London, Europe and Dubai with the opportunity to grow as the agency scales.
 



 We value initiative, problem\-solving, and people who actively look for better, faster, and smarter ways to work.

data.jd_text:
**Job Description:** 
 Project Manager – Civil Construction Works (Hydropower Plant Project)
 



**Location** 
 : Remote Project Site, Zambia Department: Project Delivery / Construction Reports To: Project Director / Construction Director Employment Type: Fixed\-Term Contract / Full\-Time Residential Site Role
 



  





**Please note that this role is based in Zambia and is a 2\-year project on a remote site** 




  





**Job Purpose** 




 The Project Manager – Civil Construction Works is responsible for the planning, coordination, execution, and control of all civil construction activities for a hydropower plant project located in a very remote area of Zambia. The role is accountable for delivering the civil works safely, on schedule, within budget, and to the required quality standards, while managing contractors, site resources, logistics, stakeholder interfaces, and compliance with environmental, social, and statutory requirements. The position requires strong leadership in a challenging remote\-site environment, including oversight of camp\-based operations, workforce welfare, and critical supply\-chain constraints.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 •
 



 Lead and manage all civil construction works for the hydropower plant, including access roads, earthworks, river diversion works, intake structures, canals, penstocks foundations and supports, powerhouse civil works, tailrace structures, drainage systems, retaining structures, concrete works, and associated temporary works.
 



 •
 



 Develop and maintain the detailed construction execution plan, site mobilisation plan, look\-ahead schedules, and resource plans aligned with the overall project programme.
 



 •
 



 Manage contractors, subcontractors, suppliers, and site supervision teams to achieve project milestones and maintain productivity in a remote\-site environment.
 



 •
 



 Monitor project progress against approved baseline schedule and budget; identify delays, risks, and cost overruns early and implement corrective actions.
 



 •
 



 Ensure all civil works are executed in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, method statements, quality plans, and contract requirements.
 



 •
 



 Coordinate closely with design, geotechnical, hydrology, electromechanical, environmental, social, and commissioning teams to manage interfaces and avoid disruption to the project programme.
 



 •
 



 Chair daily, weekly, and monthly construction meetings; issue action trackers and ensure timely close\-out of agreed actions.
 



 •
 



 Oversee site logistics for a remote location, including transport planning, materials delivery, fuel management, equipment availability, camp facilities coordination, and contingency planning for weather, road access, and supply\-chain interruptions.
 



 •
 



 Establish and enforce robust health, safety, environmental, and community protection standards across all civil work fronts.
 



 •
 



 Promote a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with project HSE plans, permit\-to\-work requirements, incident reporting, emergency preparedness, and statutory obligations.
 



 •
 



 Lead quality assurance and quality control activities, including inspections, testing, non\-conformance management, punch lists, and handover documentation.
 



 •
 



 Review and approve contractor work programmes, method statements, inspection and test plans, progress claims, and change requests in line with delegated authority.
 



 •
 



 Manage commercial and contractual matters related to the civil works, including measurement, variations, claims support, progress certification inputs, and records management.
 



 •
 



 Prepare accurate weekly and monthly progress reports covering safety, schedule, cost, quality, risks, labour, plant, materials, and key decisions required.
 



 •
 



 Engage with clients, consultants, local authorities, regulators, and surrounding communities in a professional manner that supports project delivery and good stakeholder relationships.
 



 •
 



 Ensure compliance with Zambian legal and regulatory requirements, permit conditions, labour obligations, and environmental and social commitments applicable to the project.
 



 •
 



 Support recruitment, onboarding, performance management, and development of site engineering and supervisory personnel.
 



 •
 



 Drive continuous improvement in productivity, construction methodology, cost control, and field coordination.
 



  





**Qualifications and Experience** 




 •Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related engineering discipline.
 



 •
 



 Professional registration with the Engineering Institution of Zambia (EIZ) or eligibility to obtain registration will be an advantage.
 



 •
 



 Minimum of 10–15 years of relevant experience in heavy civil construction, with at least 5 years in a senior project management role.
 



 •
 



 Proven experience on hydropower, dam, water infrastructure, tunnelling, or similarly complex civil infrastructure projects.
 



 •
 



 Demonstrated experience managing construction works in remote or logistically challenging locations.
 



 •
 



 Strong knowledge of contract administration, construction planning, budgeting, cost control, and risk management.
 



 •
 



 Practical experience with concrete works, geotechnical conditions, temporary works, earthworks, foundations, and water\-retaining structures.
 



 •
 



 Good understanding of HSE management, quality systems, and environmental and social compliance requirements on infrastructure projects.
 



 •
 



 Proficiency in project planning and reporting tools such as Primavera P6 or Microsoft Project, and standard Microsoft Office applications.
 



 •
 



 Valid driver’s licence and willingness to work on a full\-time residential basis at a remote site.
 



  





**Key Competencies** 




 •
 



 Strong leadership and team\-management capability in multicultural, camp\-based, and high\-pressure environments.
 



 •
 



 Excellent planning, coordination, and organisational skills.
 



 •
 



 Strong commercial awareness and decision\-making ability.
 



 •
 



 Ability to manage multiple contractors and interfaces simultaneously.
 



 •
 



 Clear communication and reporting skills.
 



 •
 



 High level of resilience, adaptability, and problem\-solving in isolated locations.
 



 •
 



 Strong commitment to safety, quality, ethics, and compliance.
 



 •
 



 Ability to build productive relationships with clients, consultants, authorities, community representatives, and internal teams.
 



  





**Working Conditions** 




 •Full\-time residential role based at a remote project site in Zambia.
 



 •Work is performed in a challenging construction environment with exposure to weather, rugged terrain, limited local services, and variable access conditions.
 



 •The role may require roster\-based work cycles, extended site presence, and irregular hours during critical construction phases.
 



 •Frequent interaction with contractors, plant operators, camp services, local communities, and regulatory stakeholders is expected.
 



 •The position holder must be physically fit for regular movement across active construction areas and remote work fronts.
 



  





**Key Performance Indicators** 




 •
 



 Achievement of construction milestones in line with the approved baseline programme.
 



 •
 



 Performance against approved project budget and cost forecasts.
 



 •
 



 Safety performance, including proactive risk management and incident reduction.
 



 •
 



 Quality performance, including inspection pass rates, reduced rework, and timely close\-out of non\-conformances.
 



 •
 



 Effective contractor performance and productivity management.
 



 •
 



 Timeliness and accuracy of project reporting and decision support.
 



 •
 



 Compliance with legal, contractual, environmental, and social obligations.
 



 •
 



 Successful management of remote\-site logistics and continuity of operations.
 



  





**Ideal Candidate Profile** 




 The ideal candidate is a hands\-on civil construction leader with deep infrastructure delivery experience, strong remote\-site management capability, and a proven record of safely delivering complex hydro or heavy civil projects under challenging logistical conditions. The person should be disciplined, practical, commercially aware, and capable of leading diverse teams while maintaining high standards of safety, quality, stakeholder management, and execution certainty.

data.raw_snippet:

 Provides an efficient, accurate and timely Contracts and Purchasing Service for internal clients according to University policies and procedures. Focuses on vendor management. Ensures that each purchase is value for money and cost effective.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose Summary**
 Provides an efficient, accurate and timely Contracts and Purchasing Service for internal clients according to University policies and procedures. Focuses on vendor management. Ensures that each purchase is value for money and cost effective.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
 GENERAL PURCHASING
   

  

* Purchases a variety of goods and services for both Campuses from local and international sources in line with the University By\-Laws.
* Materials procured range from: computers (hardware, software, consumables, accessories), audio video equipment, office equipment, office and classroom furniture, lab equipment, printing materials, stationery, text books, periodicals, vehicles, building materials and renovation services, rental of equipment/vehicles and maintaining the University Insurance Policies (Public Liability, Fire, Burglary and Vehicular), for both campuses.
* Interprets purchase requests, investigates supply sources and negotiates best terms and conditions in line with user specifications.
* Scrutinizes specifications carefully to ensure that they are generic in nature during enquiry preparation stage, and to advise or obtain clarification from end user when such anomalies appear.
* Solicits quotations in line with the purchasing method approved by the Director/line manager. Scrutinizes vendor quotations and prepares bid summaries as required. Makes recommendations where possible.
* Vets and benchmarks prices obtained through referring to historical data, web published prices, and/or checking with end users to compare budgeted and estimated costs with actual prices.
* Expedites orders to ensure that goods and services are delivered within contractual deadlines and ensures that end users are kept advised of delivery situation at all times.
* Liaises with vendors regarding discrepancies and damage reports to ensure correct replacement of materials in accordance with order specifications.
* Issues amendments in case of increase/decrease of quantities and cancellation of orders and ensures accuracy of data at all times.
* Ensures through liaison with end users that vendor invoices routed for payment approval, are not held up without reason.
* When requested by line manager, must be able to produce and place on record the complete history of a specific purchase, for presentation or audit purposes.
* Answers vendor and client queries as required.


 TENDERS
   

  

* Prepares vendor tender documents complete with technical specifications, conditions, bill of quantities, date for opening envelopes, tender validity, terms of payment and guarantee, in line with the Director’s/line manager’s instructions.
* Monitors closing dates for tenders and ensures that tender opening sessions are held on the day of closing.
* Receives tender documents and prepares appropriate record in preparation of the tender opening session.
* Passes on all tenders with appropriate record to the tender opening committee.
* Forwards technical documents/catalogues to appointed Technical Committee for technical evaluation. Addresses clarifications arising from technical queries by evaluation teams.
* On receipt of technical evaluation from end user, opens Commercial envelopes and prepares the Bid Summary.
* On the advice of the Director/ line manager, prepares orders/fax of intent.
* Prepares blanket orders according to standards, procedures and University By\-Laws.
* Collects Performance Bonds and Bank Guarantees and maintains their security through the Finance Department. Returns bonds to unsuccessful vendors as required.
* Monitors contractual delivery and completion deadlines and liaises with Contracts Specialist for any delays in contract delivery.


**Other**
* Must be fully conversant with, and able to prepare and issue requests for quotations on the Tejari.com business to business exchange.
* Must be fully conversant with the Purchasing module of the Banner System and be able to process Purchase Requisitions and Purchase Orders in line with adopted procedures.
* Maintains confidentiality of purchasing information and does not disseminate information to any Party, unless authorized by the Director/line manager.
* Maintains a comprehensive knowledge of all procedures in the By\-Laws and the University’s purchasing terms and conditions.
* Must be conversant with the Storekeeper’s functions to fill in duties when required to do so.
* Identify, mitigate and escalate procurement risks to enable the organization to meet its obligations and maximize business opportunities
* Maintain and update procurement records and generate reports on procurement and contract activity to meet organizational compliance requirements and provide access to procurement information
* Performs other related duties as assigned and needed.


 DEGREE OF INDEPENDENCE/COMPLEXITY OF ENVIRONMENT
   

  

* Works independently to deal with different clients while maintaining confidentiality and a professional manner. Coordinates and directs a variety of purchasing requests, tenders, queries and correspondence. Mainly works to meet deadlines and must be able to function under time constraints.


 WORKING RELATIONSHIPS/IMPACT OF INTERACTIONS
   

  

* Works closely with the Director/line manager, C\&P, members in the Department and other departments, particularly Finance to ensure that the complete procurement cycle is completed effectively, through payment of invoices to vendors.
* Must communicate effectively and professionally with internal and external clients.


**Education \& Experience Requirements**
 Must possess a Minimum of a bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution and 2 years relevant professional experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
   

  

 Experience working in a similar role in a government or higher education institution will be highly preferred.
   

  

**Other Requirements**
* Excellent computer skills required.
* Knowledge of purchasing procedures is preferred.
* Arabic/ English bilingual an asset.


 COMPETENCIES
   

  

* Communication \-Able to share information in an effective \& collaborative manner, both verbally and in writing.
* Customer \& Service Focused \- Demonstrates a spirit of service excellence
* Results \& Action Orientation \- Demonstrates initiative to generate improvements and foster positive outcomes.
* Builds Effective Interpersonal Relationships \- Demonstrates interpersonal effectiveness in the workplace.
* Knowledge \& Technical Competency \- Demonstrates proficiency in technical and job knowledge aspects of the position to achieve high level of performance. Able and willing to learn.

* Lead the development of comprehensive project plans, including scope, timelines, budgets, resource allocation, and risk mitigation strategies.

* Ensure projects are delivered in accordance with luxury hospitality standards, brand guidelines, and operational requirements.
* Proactively manage project risks, issues, and dependencies to minimize impact on resort operations and guest experience.

* Integrate sustainability initiatives, energy efficiency, and best environmental practices into all project stages.
* Ensure projects align with the resort’s sustainability goals and international hospitality standards.

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Project Management, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 3–5 years of relevant experience in project management within the hospitality, luxury hotel, or high\-end construction sector.
* Proven experience managing capital projects, renovations, and operational upgrades in occupied hotels or resorts.


**Technical \& Professional Skills**
* Strong knowledge of project management methodologies, construction processes, and hospitality operations.
* Solid understanding of Dubai Municipality regulations and local authority requirements.
* Proficiency in MS Office Suite and project management software.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

data.raw_snippet:
**About The Role**
 The Art Director is a senior creative delivery role within M\+C Saatchi Sport \& Entertainment Middle East, responsible for leading the visual and conceptual development of sport and events campaigns across the agency's client portfolio.
   

  

 Reporting to the Senior Client D
data.jd_text:
**About The Role**
 The Art Director is a senior creative delivery role within M\+C Saatchi Sport \& Entertainment Middle East, responsible for leading the visual and conceptual development of sport and events campaigns across the agency's client portfolio.
   

  

 Reporting to the Senior Client Director, the Art Director will take briefs from strategy and account teams and translate them into compelling creative territories, campaign identities, event experiences, and activation assets that perform across all channels and touchpoints.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on, high\-output role suited to a creative who understands the energy, pace, and visual language of sport and live events. You will be expected to concept and create at speed, uphold quality standards across a busy client roster, and contribute to the creative direction of the agency's most visible and complex campaigns.
   

  

 The Art Director will play an important role in shaping the agency's creative output \- working across event branding, sponsorship activations, fan engagement, social content and pitch development \- while supporting and developing the wider creative team.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Campaign Creative \& Concept Development**
* Lead creative development from brief to delivery across sports and events campaigns, ensuring all work is on\-brief, on\-brand, and commercially sound.
* Translate strategic briefs into visual creative territories, mood boards, campaign frameworks and creative rationales.
* Develop and present multiple creative routes with clarity and confidence, both internally and in client\-facing settings.
* Oversee creative quality and visual consistency across all client touchpoints and across the full campaign lifecycle.


**Sports \& Events Creative**
* Design and develop event identity systems, environmental branding, wayfinding, fan zone concepts and large\-format experiential assets.
* Create campaign visual assets for major sporting events, sponsor activations, athlete partnerships and fan engagement activations.
* Produce creative across OOH, digital, social, print, broadcast and environmental formats as required by client campaigns.
* Stay ahead of design and visual communication trends in global sports marketing, live events and fan culture.


**Client \& Agency Presentations**
* Support the development of new business pitch decks, credentials presentations and agency marketing materials.
* Present creative work to clients with confidence, manage feedback clearly and see revisions through to final artwork.
* Help the agency bring creative ambition to pitches and proposals, positioning M\+C Saatchi S\&E ME as a best\-in\-class creative partner.


**Creative Team \& Production**
* Brief, direct and review work from freelance designers, illustrators, photographers and video producers.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously, maintaining quality and meeting deadlines without compromising standards.
* Oversee artwork trafficking and file management, ensuring all assets are delivered to specification for print and digital use.
* Manage relationships with print suppliers, production studios and external creative partners where required.
* Support and mentor junior members of the creative team, helping to build capability and a culture of high standards.


**Cross\-Department Collaboration**
* Work closely across all departments to deliver integrated creative solutions.
* Collaborate with the Social Media team to ensure campaign creative works effectively across all social platforms.
* Contribute to internal creative reviews and help raise the quality of creative output across all agency accounts.


 ABOUT YOU
   

  

**Essential**
* 5\+ years of experience as an Art Director, Senior Designer or equivalent creative role, with a strong portfolio demonstrating sport and/or events work.
* Exceptional design craft with a sharp eye for typography, layout, colour and visual storytelling.
* Proven experience across multiple formats: campaign identities, event branding, social content, large\-format production and presentation design.
* Expert\-level proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite: Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign.
* Strong conceptual thinking \- able to generate original ideas and develop them from sketch to final delivery.
* Experience working in a fast\-paced agency environment managing multiple client briefs simultaneously.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills \- confident in client\-facing situations.
* Understanding of the GCC and Middle East market, cultural sensitivities and visual communication norms.


**Desirable**
* Proven experience on major sporting events \- rugby, football, motorsport, tennis, athletics or equivalent.
* Motion graphics and video editing skills: After Effects, Premiere Pro.
* Experience working with government entities, tourism boards, rights holders or sports federations in the region.
* Bilingual creative capability in English and Arabic.


**What Great Looks Like**
 Success in this role means producing creative that is confident, original and purposeful \- work that wins pitches, elevates client campaigns and makes the agency proud.
   

  

 You are the person who brings energy and clarity to a brief. You concept quickly, execute with precision, and know how to read a room when presenting. You understand the difference between a great idea and a great execution \- and you deliver both.
   

  

 You work well with strategy and account teams without needing to be spoon\-fed. You push back constructively when a brief is not right, and you take responsibility for quality at every stage of the process.
   

  

 You are as comfortable art directing an event identity system for a major sports property as you are turning around a social asset for a sponsor activation at pace. You understand sport, you understand the region, and you bring both to your work.
   

  

 Ready to lead. Built for sport and entertainment industry. Focused on quality, originality and delivery.
   

  

 This role is suited to a strong, confident Art Director who wants to be at the centre of one of the region's most exciting creative agency environments.
   

  

**Applications close on Friday, June 26, 2026\.**
**About Our Local Office**
 We were born out of the need for strategic and brutally effective creativity in the region. With every successful campaign, we have grown, and cherry\-picked the best professionals to work with us from all over the region and the world. In 2012, we opened our Abu Dhabi office and expanded our team with our Dubai office in 2016 and then our Riyadh office in 2023\. From these offices we manage a number of local and global brands across the Middle East and Europe. Brutal Simplicity of Thought is the creative philosophy of M\+C Saatchi. It defines the way we work and the work we produce. We believe: It’s easier to complicate than simplify. Simple ideas enter the brain quicker and stay there longer. Brutal Simplicity of Thought is therefore a painful necessity.
   

  

 ABOUT M\+C SAATCHI GROUP
   

  

 M\+C Saatchi Group is a creative federation of companies who navigate, create, and lead meaningful change for clients across five specialist divisions connected through people, culture, data, technology and creativity, M\+C Saatchi Group aims to unlock new value for clients and leave a positive impact on the world. M\+C Saatchi Group’s work is informed by two core principles \- Brutal Simplicity of Thought and Diversity of Thought. Together they guide how problems are solved and integrated specialist teams are built. Headquartered in London, M\+C Saatchi Group have circa 2,500 employees globally. Our global operations span 23 countries with major hubs in the UK, Europe, Middle East \& Africa, Asia and Australia.
   

  

 OUR AMBITION
   

  

 At M\+C Saatchi Group, our ambition is to create and curate Cultural Power for our clients. We do this by connecting specialist expertise, powered by creativity, data and technology, to help build famous brands and solve the most complex business and societal challenges.

 Operations Transformation

 Business \& Technology Coordination
   

  

* Act as a key link between operational teams and technology delivery teams.

* Coordinate cross\-functional inputs and help manage dependencies across multiple workstreams.

 Defect \& Issue Management
   

  

* Coordinate defect and issue management activities across the workstream.

* Support the tracking, prioritization, and resolution of system and process issues.

 Stakeholder Collaboration
   

  

* Build effective working relationships with operational teams, business users, technical delivery teams, and external partners.

 Key Requirements
   

  

* Proven experience as a Project Manager supporting business and technology transformation initiatives.

* Experience working within multi\-stream programs with complex dependencies.

* Experience with project governance, reporting, risk management, and dependency tracking.
* Experience supporting testing, operational readiness, and transition activities.
* Strong organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience within the insurance or financial services sector.
* Exposure to health insurance operations, claims processing, policy administration, billing, or reimbursement functions.
* Experience working within large international organizations or consulting environments.
* Familiarity with Agile or hybrid project delivery methodologies.
* Project Management certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile are advantageous.


 Other Details
   

  

 This consulting assignment is based in Dubai and is part of a business transformation initiative within the insurance sector, focusing on technology migration and operations transformation.

data.jd_text:
**Responsibilities:** 



* Provide inputs to the development of the overall division strategy and participate in developing the business unit strategy in line with the vision, mission, and business objectives of the company.
* Deliver the Facilities Management strategy while ensuring contractual commitments are successfully met.
* Manage the effective achievement of the business unit’s objectives through leading the Facilities and Operations team in the assigned project, by setting individual objectives, managing performance, developing and motivating staff, and providing formal and informal feedback and appraisals in order to maximize the subordinates’ and the business unit’s performance.
* Contribute and assist the director of operations in defining an optimum structure for the business unit/ division so that resources are optimally utilized, and communication takes place in an efficient manner.
* Recommend and oversee the budget for the business unit and monitor financial performance versus the budget so that the business is aware of anticipated costs/ revenues, areas of unsatisfactory performance and potential areas of cost reduction are identified, and performance improvement opportunities are realized.
* Lead and manage the Facilities Management function while ensuring the planning and allocation of all resources, and the implementation of the appropriate standards and controls to ensure that all the unit activities are carried out in an efficient and effective manner to meet and exceed unit objectives.
* Discuss “Side\-Specific\-Budgets” with customers including CAPEX for example, advise the customers on expenditures, opportunities for cost reductions, and the viability/ feasibility of changing/ buying assets (such as changing a chiller for example) to ensure customers’ budgeting is as appropriate and as accurate as possible.
* Develop and monitor SLAs for the assets, and ensure that they are aligned to service delivery, client expectations, and expectations from suppliers / service partners in order to achieve quality service delivery, effective supplier relationship management, and profitability.
* Monitor service delivery performance and lead the evaluation of suppliers’ performance to ensure the selection of appropriately qualified service providers at the optimum price in order to deliver the expected quality of service.
* Monitor resource utilization to ensure that the right number and talent is available for running operations (projects, civil works, mechanical works, electrical works, landscaping, building inspections, etc.), accomplishing targets, improving customer satisfaction, and achieving business objectives.
* Monitor and control the execution of maintenance contracts, review the preventive and corrective maintenance programs, and supervise the implementation by employees or assigned contractor(s) through reviewing reports and spot\-checking as appropriate to ensure the provision of quality maintenance works to the facilities (including maintenance to audio visual equipment, BMS, chillers, generators, HVAC, IT, etc.).
* Attend all coordination meetings with the tenants and contractors to discuss the progress of the fit out works and collect the required documentation, carry out an overall inspection after the completion of the fit out works, prepare the snag list to for the tenant, and follow up on all rectification works needed.
* Monitor the request for quotations and the preparation of Purchase Orders and Vendor Contracts, approve same, and ensure that the purchasing process is optimized to guarantee the provision of products/ services to the company/ customer on time and avoid any operational delays.
* Ensure that the Annual Leave Planer is completed to have a holistic view on forecasted leaves and employees’ availabilities throughout the year so as to guarantee that the appropriate resourcing is done and that business operations do not get interrupted.
* Manage customers’ expectations through clear communication and transparent work attitude in order to be consistent and to develop strong customer relationships.
* Receive escalated problems and complaints from the Call Centre and ensure that the necessary support and maintenance work is provided to customers in a timely fashion in order to resolve customers’ issues (pertaining to cooling, power, ventilation, plumbing, etc.) and maintain their high levels of satisfaction.
* Escort customers on daily tours within the premises/ facilities, listen to any feedback or complaints they might have, and delegate any work needed to the subordinates in order to provide customers with the necessary civil, mechanical, electrical, etc. support and maintenance support.
* Provide technical advice to customers and represent customers in technical interfaces with third parties (such as dealing with contractors conducting any construction work on premises while ensuring that they are delivering according to the agreement) as well as furnish customers with technical advice on improvement opportunities (such as reducing utility consumption and bills) in order to increase CSR awareness and contribute in achieving a greener environment.
* Manage the implementation and improvement of policies, guidelines, and processes for contract management and administration to ensure standards are set so that all business requirements are fulfilled while delivering a quality service to customers in line with the corporate strategy.
* Manage the process of revising contracts’ scope of work, renewing the contract while recommending changes, conducting pricing, and negotiating the contract with the customer while coordinating the Terms \& Conditions of the contract with the Legal department to ensure alignment with internal policies and any external laws and regulations.
* Lead and monitor the subcontracting of works (such as fire systems, gas, emergency lighting, vertical transportation, water treatment, tank cleaning, etc.), ensure that subcontractors fulfil their duties in an accurate manner and as per the agreed upon contractual clauses, and manage subcontractors’ evaluations and negotiations while ensuring that chosen subcontractors are approved by the relevant authorities to guarantee compliance with the regulatory framework (such as any approvals needed from the Civil Defense Department for fire\-fighting systems).
* Ensure effective planning and implementation of HSEEQ inspections and audits in order to meet regulatory requirements and company standards.
* Monitor physical and documentation audits being conducted on subcontractors to ensure that work is being conducted properly and that customers are being served with the highest quality standards, and take the necessary actions upon the detection of unreported/ undisclosed variations and/ or poor performance to safeguard the company against any liabilities.
* Lead the audits of staff, customers, and suppliers to gather feedback and monitor satisfaction in order to improve the operations and facilities management services the company provides.
* Develop and ensure the implementation of division policies, procedures, and controls covering all areas of activity so that all relevant procedural/ legislative requirements are fulfilled while delivering a quality and cost\-effective service.
* Ensure compliance to all relevant quality, health, safety, and environmental management policies, procedures, and controls across the department to guarantee employee safety, legislative compliance, delivery of high quality products/ service and a responsible environmental attitude.
* Ensure corrective actions and preventive actions issued by the HSEEQ department are implemented, update the HSEEQ department about the progress of the implementation.
* Ensure the legionella reporting is timely sent to HSEEQ department.
* Ensure the HIRAs are finalized and yearly updated, with support of the HSEQ department.
* Ensure the risk control measures arising from the HIRA are properly implemented.
* Ensure availability of MS and RA



  





**Qualifications, Experiences, Skills**



* Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, preferably with a Master’s degree in Management or Facilities Management; CMMS knowledge is also preferable
* 10 – 12 years’ experience in operations management including 5 years in a managerial role; exposure to Maintenance and Facilities Management in hospitality projects.

**Company Description** 
 The FF\&E Source FZCO (operating internationally as FF\&E International) is a boutique FF\&E and OS\&E procurement consultancy with over 50 years of combined leadership experience. The company supports developers, owners, and operators in optimizing ROI, reducing operational inefficiencies, and elevating guest experiences across luxury hotels, serviced residences, and high\-end branded real estate. Its team has delivered iconic hospitality projects across the Middle East, Africa, the Indian Ocean, the Far East, Europe, and the Philippines. Combining a designer’s eye with robust supply chain expertise and rigorous project management, The FF\&E Source maintains design integrity from concept through installation via its proprietary procurement platform, IFECT. Headquartered in Dubai with offices in the UK and Netherlands, the company has worked on notable projects such as Raffles The Red Sea and Fairmont The Red Sea for leading developers.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Senior FF\&E Project Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, responsible for leading end\-to\-end FF\&E procurement for complex hospitality and real estate projects. This role oversees project planning, scheduling, budgeting, and execution, ensuring alignment with client requirements, design intent, and brand standards from concept through to installation. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include coordinating with designers, owners, operators, suppliers, and internal teams; managing RFQs, tenders, and purchase orders; and tracking production, quality inspections, logistics, and installation milestones. The Senior FF\&E Project Manager will monitor project risks, maintain accurate documentation and reporting via the IFECT platform, and drive continuous improvement in processes and supplier performance. The role also involves mentoring junior team members and contributing to best practices, templates, and standards across the project management function.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Strong project management skills, including Project Management and experience leading FF\&E/OS\&E scopes from concept through installation.
* Demonstrated expediting capabilities, including Expeditor and Expediting skills to drive timely production, approvals, and deliveries.
* Experience with inspection and quality control, including Inspection skills to verify compliance with specifications, samples, and mock\-ups.
* Proficiency in Logistics Management, including coordination of shipping, warehousing, and on\-site delivery sequencing for multiple projects.
* Several years of experience in hospitality or high\-end real estate FF\&E/OS\&E procurement and project delivery, ideally in an international environment.
* Ability to read and interpret design documentation, specifications, and schedules, with a strong eye for detail and design integrity.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and negotiation skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams.
* High level of proficiency with project management and procurement software platforms;

**About The Job**
 Tether Wallet carries the Tether name, it is a self\-custodial wallet used by people around the world to hold, send, and transact with USDt, XAUt, USAt, and BTC. We move fast, we ship to a global audience, and every release touches engineering, design, legal, compliance, licensing, expansion, marketing, and customer support before it goes out the door.
   

  

 We're hiring a Project Manager to sit next to the Product Manager and own the process of getting features from spec to launch across every team that touches them.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Your job is to make sure that once a feature is spec'd, it actually gets delivered on time, with every dependency handled, with no stakeholder left waiting on something they needed a week ago.
   

  

**You'll Be The Person Who**
* Stakeholders orchestration. Every Tether Wallet feature touches engineering, design, legal, compliance, licensing, expansion, marketing, and customer support. You're the single point of coordination across all of them, knowing what each team needs, when they need it, what they owe back, and how their work plugs into the release timeline. When something's off\-track in any lane, you see it first and you act on it.
* Runs releases end\-to\-end. From sprint planning through QA, bug triage, legal sign\-off, compliance review, support enablement, marketing coordination, and launch.
* Tracks every dependency across every stakeholder and surfaces risks before they become blockers.
* Followup with people. Stakeholders dragging their feet on a deliverable that's blocking a release is your problem to solve.
* Translates between technical and non\-technical stakeholders. Engineering speaks one language, legal speaks another, marketing a third. You're the connective tissue.

* Excellent communication skills, written and spoken. You can write a clear status update, run a focused meeting, send a crisp Slack message, and adapt your tone for engineers, lawyers, marketers, and executives
* Proven track record collaborating with diverse stakeholders. Orchestrating releases across engineering plus at least three non\-engineering functions (legal, compliance, marketing, support, design, etc.)

* Highly charismatic communicator who can motivate teams, create buy\-in, and move people to action without relying on formal authority.

 Proficiency in English (spoken and written).

data.jd_text:
Company Overview
 




 Meinhardt is one of the world’s most respected engineering consultancies, with a proven track record of delivering innovative, buildable, and sustainable solutions across buildings, infrastructure, and mission\-critical facilities. With over 6,000 professionals across 61 offices worldwide, Meinhardt partners with leading developers, governments, and private clients to shape cities and communities..
 



  






 Our Vision, Mission \& Values
 



* Vision: Be the world’s preferred urban \& infrastructure solutions provider.
* Mission: Deliver commercially successful, highly buildable, sustainable solutions exceeding clients’ expectations.
* Values: Accountability, Collaboration, Diversity, Entrepreneurship, Integrity, Innovation, Ownership, Respect, Sustainability.



  






 Position Overview
 




 We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Project Manager – Data Centers to lead the delivery of mission\-critical projects across the Middle East region. The role involves managing multidisciplinary design teams, coordinating stakeholders, and ensuring successful project delivery from concept through commissioning.
 



  






 Responsibilities
 



* Lead the delivery of hyperscale, colocation, enterprise, and mission\-critical data center projects from concept through construction support and commissioning.
* Act as the primary point of contact for clients throughout the project lifecycle.
* Manage multidisciplinary teams including architecture, structural, mechanical, electrical, ELV, fire, and specialist consultants.
* Develop and maintain project execution plans, schedules, resource plans, and delivery strategies.
* Ensure projects are delivered in accordance with scope, budget, program, quality requirements, and client expectations.
* Lead design coordination meetings, technical workshops, progress reviews, and client presentations.
* Monitor project commercial performance including fee management, scope control, variation management, and contract administration.
* Identify and manage project risks, technical challenges, and stakeholder expectations.
* Coordinate with authorities, operators, contractors, vendors, and specialist consultants.
* Support business development activities, proposal preparation, and client relationship management.
* Mentor project teams and support the development of junior project managers and discipline leads.



  






 Qualifications \& Experience
 



* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Architecture, or a related discipline.
* Master’s degree is preferred.
* Minimum 15 years of experience in engineering consultancy, design management, or project delivery.
* Proven experience delivering large\-scale data center projects within a consultancy environment.
* Strong understanding of mission\-critical infrastructure including power, cooling, telecommunications, security, and resilience requirements.
* Experience managing multidisciplinary design teams and stakeholders.
* Strong commercial, contractual, and project management skills.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and client\-facing skills.



  






 Preferred Attributes
 



* Experience delivering hyperscale data center campuses.
* Strong understanding of Uptime Institute Tier Standards, TIA\-942, ASHRAE, and mission\-critical design principles.
* Experience working with major international data center operators, cloud providers, and developers.
* Experience delivering projects throughout the UAE, Saudi Arabia, and wider GCC region.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and stakeholders simultaneously while maintaining high standards of quality and client satisfaction.



  





 Please submit /forward your CV to recruitment.mena@meinhardtgroup.com if you meet the above requirements.
 



  





 Good Luck

**About Woods Bagot – Architecture for Worlds Ahead** 




 We design places that meet the challenges and opportunities of our rapidly changing world. Our commitment to exploration, impact and community creates enduring, forward‑thinking outcomes, unlocking humanity’s highest potential. With a global design culture devoted to creativity, resilience, and purpose – we ensure every project contributes to our client’s vision, inspiring future generations.
 



  





 Woods Bagot is part of the 7C Network. The 7C Network is an integrated network of design and architecture companies that provides “Total Place Design,” a holistic approach to creating transformative environments. It combines capabilities from its constituent brands – including Woods Bagot, ERA\-co, Impact Futures, and Customs Bureau – to offer services in placemaking, sustainability, architecture and interior design, and luxury concepts.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are seeking an experienced Project Leader to join our Dubai Studio and play a key role in the successful design and delivery of major projects across the Middle East and Europe. The successful candidate will initially lead a significant rail infrastructure project before transitioning to support and lead other key projects across our diverse portfolio. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Architect who enjoys working across complex, multidisciplinary environments and is motivated by designing and delivering high\-profile projects that shape cities and communities.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Lead the delivery of major projects from planning and design through to construction and completion.
* Initially provide leadership on a significant rail infrastructure project, ensuring successful delivery against programme, budget, and design objectives.
* Manage project resources, budgets, and risk throughout the project lifecycle.
* Act as the primary point of contact for clients, stakeholders, authorities, and project partners.
* Coordinate multidisciplinary teams, including architecture, engineering, planning, urban design, and specialist consultants.
* Facilitate stakeholder engagement, design coordination, and project review meetings.
* Ensure compliance with client requirements, local regulations, and project governance processes.
* Monitor project performance and proactively identify and resolve project challenges.
* Support business development activities and contribute to the pursuit of new project opportunities.
* Mentor and develop team members, fostering a collaborative and high\-performing project environment.



  





**About You** 




 You are an experienced Architectural Project Leader with a proven ability to lead the design and delivery of complex, large\-scale projects. Combining strong design sensibility with effective project leadership, you are skilled at managing clients, consultants, and multidisciplinary teams to deliver high\-quality architectural outcomes across all stages of a project's lifecycle.
 



  





**Qualifications and Experience:** 



* 15\+ years' experience designing and delivering complex architectural projects.
* Previous experience working on rail projects.
* Demonstrated experience delivering large\-scale, design\-led projects with multiple stakeholders and complex coordination requirements.
* Experience working on transportation, rail, aviation, civic, mixed\-use, commercial, or other major development projects would be highly advantageous.
* Strong understanding of architectural project delivery, including design management, consultant coordination, project planning, and contract administration.
* Excellent design leadership, communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Degree qualification in Architecture; professional registration or chartership is desirable.
* Experience working within the UAE or broader Middle East region, with an understanding of local project delivery processes and regulatory requirements.
* A collaborative leadership style with a passion for mentoring, developing, and inspiring team members.
* Strong appreciation of design quality, technical excellence, and the delivery of innovative architectural solutions.



  





**How to Apply** 




 Applicants are required to submit a resume and portfolio via our Project Leader \- Rail LinkedIn Job Post. Due to file upload restrictions we recommend providing a link to your portfolio within your resume. Applications will be treated in the strictest confidence. We do not accept unsolicited resumes or names from agencies. All personal data collected by us will be kept confidential and only used for recruitment purposes.
 



  





**Mandatory Requirement: It is an essential requirement that at the time of applying for this position, applicants must have the legal right to work in the UAE.** 




  





**7C \- Total Place Design Network** 




 7C is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, colour, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, and Veteran status. At 7C, we are committed to creating an environment where difference is celebrated, valued and respected, practices are equitable, and our people feel like they belong. We accept that none of us is smarter than all of us. We believe building a diverse workforce is the foundation to creativity and innovative design – it is only by working together that we can realise the potential of our people, clients and communities around us. Through our inclusive leadership and our truly global studio network, you will find your voice and have the support and flexibility required to bring your whole self to work and build an exceptional career.

data.jd_text:
**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a senior technology leader to scale and expand our financial technology platform as the company expands across markets, products, partners, and regions.
 



  





 This role is suited for someone who can operate both strategically and hands\-on when needed, but whose main strength is building systems, teams, ownership models, and engineering discipline that do not depend on a single individual.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Own technology strategy, architecture, engineering delivery, and platform operations.
* Ensure high availability, resilience, observability, and incident readiness across critical systems.
* Support the company’s cybersecurity posture across ISIEM, SOC, DLP, EDR/XDR, vulnerability management, penetration testing, threat modelling, monitoring, incident response, and security awareness.
* Lead the practical adoption of Agentic AI across engineering and technology operations.
* Strengthen security, compliance, audit readiness, access controls, data protection, and secure SDLC practices.
* Build and mature NOC/SOC capabilities, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, escalation, and post\-incident reviews.
* Scale the platform and the technical team for geographical expansion, including multi\-market readiness, localisation needs, regulatory expectations, and infrastructure scalability.
* Manage technical relationships with third\-party providers of core services, including issuing processors, payment providers, banking partners, cloud vendors, security vendors, and integration platforms.
* Improve ownership models, documentation, Runbooks, SLAs, and operational accountability.
* Partner with Product, Finance, Operations, Risk, Compliance, and executive leadership.
* Reduce key\-person dependency and help build a reliable leadership structure across engineering and operations.



  





**Qualifications and Experience** 



* 10\+ years Senior technology leadership experience in a roles VP Engineering/ Technology, Head of Engineering/Technology, or similar.
* Experience in fintech, specifically issuing, acquiring or banking is essential.
* Proven track record scaling reliable, secure, compliant production systems.
* Proven track record of the Agentic AI adaptation and productivity gain.
* Experience building engineering teams, technical operations, NOC/SOC processes, and delivery discipline.
* Experience with either ISO27001, SAMA, SOC2 and PCI DSS regulatory implementation and support.
* Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, backend platforms, APIs, data systems, observability, disaster recovery and incident management.
* Experience working with third\-party providers of mission\-critical services.
* Ability to operate across strategy, architecture, execution, people leadership, and executive communication.

data.jd_text:
**Manatal** 
 is an HRTech software service (B2B SaaS) company headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand. Manatal is one of the fastest\-growing start\-ups in the region and is backed by Surge and Sequoia Capital.
 



 Manatal has a global presence and is trusted by thousands of businesses in over 135 countries. Our goal is to transform the entire hiring process by making it simple, efficient, and enjoyable for recruiters, hiring managers, and candidates alike. Our mission is to offer the best\-in\-class AI\-powered technologies to empower small, medium, and large businesses in their staffing \& recruitment transformation.
 



**Head of Engineering Operations** 




 As Manatal expands into the enterprise segment, the operational demands on engineering are growing beyond what product squads can absorb alongside feature development. Internal requests, data migrations, bug triage, and customer\-facing technical work require dedicated engineering ownership to maintain quality and velocity across the organization.
 



 The Head of Engineering Operations will own this function. Reporting to the Director of Engineering, this role is responsible for all engineering work that falls outside of product feature development and platform engineering but is critical to customer satisfaction, platform reliability, and business growth. This includes building and leading a team, establishing processes and SLAs, and systematically automating operational workflows.
 



 This is a deeply technical, hands\-on leadership position. The successful candidate will write production code across our backend (Python/Django, FastAPI) and frontend (Vue.js, React) codebases, contribute to both internal tooling and customer\-facing repositories, and be capable of investigating and troubleshooting infrastructure\-level issues. This person is expected to operate at the same technical level as our Director of Engineering and Head of Platform Engineering.
 



 The role also serves as the primary engineering counterpart to the L3 support team (which reports into Customer Support), ensuring that technical escalations are resolved efficiently and that product squads remain focused on product delivery.
 



 We are looking for a candidate who is energized by high\-tempo environments, comfortable engaging directly with customers, and capable of managing multiple priorities under pressure. Strong judgment in prioritization and effective delegation are essential.
 



**Responsibilities** 




**Engineering Requests \& Customer\-Facing Support** 



* Own the intake, prioritization, and resolution of all internal engineering requests (data exports, credit adjustments, technical investigations, one\-off scripts).
* Define and enforce SLAs to provide customer\-facing teams with clear expectations and predictable response times.
* Serve as the primary engineering point of contact for the L3 support team, meeting regularly to unblock escalations and ensure timely resolution.



**Data Migrations** 



* Own the data migration process end\-to\-end: intake, scoping, execution, and validation.
* Design, build, and improve migration pipelines to significantly reduce turnaround times.
* Troubleshoot and debug migration failures across the full stack (application, database, infrastructure).
* Data migrations are among Manatal's highest\-stakes operational challenges and a key driver of customer retention.



**Software Development \& Tooling** 



* Write production code across Manatal's backend (Python/Django, FastAPI) and frontend (Vue.js, React) codebases to fix bugs, implement operational improvements, and connect systems.
* Build and maintain internal tools (Retool, custom applications) that enable customer\-facing teams to self\-serve on tasks that currently require engineering intervention.
* Maintain and update API endpoints and Open API documentation as required.
* Identify and systematically eliminate repetitive manual work through automation.



**Bug Intake, Routing \& Lifecycle** 



* Own the bug triage process: intake, severity assessment, routing to the appropriate squad, and lifecycle tracking through resolution.
* Define and maintain bug SLAs. Implement automated reporting to provide leadership with visibility into bug volume, resolution times, and trends.
* Manage vulnerability report intake and ensure findings are triaged and routed to the appropriate team.



**Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 



* Work closely with the Director of Engineering to protect squad focus by absorbing operational engineering load.
* Partner with Customer Support, Sales, and L3 to identify pain points and deliver engineering solutions.
* Exercise strong judgment on escalation: determine when to resolve directly, when to delegate within the team, and when to engage a product squad.



**Requirements** 



* 5\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience, with demonstrated ability to lead a team while remaining deeply involved in technical work.
* Strong proficiency in Python (Django and/or FastAPI), with the ability to write and ship production\-quality code.
* Experience with frontend development (Vue.js or React), including the ability to build interfaces and contribute to customer\-facing applications.
* Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure, with the ability to investigate production issues, interpret logs, and troubleshoot across the stack.
* Experience building or improving operational processes (bug triage, internal tooling, SLAs, request management).
* Demonstrated ability to work directly with customers or customer\-facing teams on technical matters.
* Strong prioritization skills and the ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams under pressure.
* People management experience.
* Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal.



**Nice to Have** 



* Experience with data migrations or data pipeline work at scale.
* Experience in a B2B platform company transitioning from SMB to enterprise.
* Background in building self\-service tooling for non\-technical teams (Retool or similar).
* Familiarity with API documentation standards (OpenAPI/Swagger).
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted workflows for operational automation.
* Experience with recruitment technology or HR tech.



**Working with Manatal** 



* This role is based at our Bangkok office in the heart of the city center
* As a team of diverse cultures and nationalities, English language proficiency is required
* We enjoy collaborating in person, and the team is working on\-site



**Why you'll enjoy working with Manatal** 



* Well\-funded start\-up backed by Surge \& Sequoia
* Be part of one of the fastest\-growing B2B SaaS start\-ups in the region
* You will be collaborating with talented individuals in the industry
* Join a lively and highly international team
* Indulge in a challenging and innovative working culture
* Attractive medical healthcare plan
* Personal development allowance
* 2 weeks of work from anywhere per year
* Regular fun team\-building activities



**Hiring Process:** 




 You can expect in our hiring process some or all of the following rounds:
 


1. Introduction interview with the HR team
2. Introduction interview with CTO and/or Director of Engineering
3. Technical Interview with technical assessment
4. Cultural fit interview with top management team



**Our Tech Stack:** 




 Our engineering team leverages a variety of modern technologies. While working at Manatal, you can expect to be exposed to the following stack:
 


* **Infrastructure:** 
 Amazon Web Services; Kubernetes; GitOps (ArgoCD), GitHub Actions, Terraform, among others.
* **Backend:**
* Language: Python (Django, FastAPI);
* Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Open/ElasticSearch, and Redis, among others;
* Other: Celery, RabbitMQ, among others.
* **Frontend:** 
 Typescript (Vue, React)



**Learn more about Manatal:** 



* Get to know more about us and our product: www.manatal.com
* Watch a product demo of Manatal product: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v\=\-GG1GqXkAKQ



**Manatal Hiring:** 
*At Manatal, we are dedicated to building an intuitive AI\-powered application tracking system to streamline and transform the entire hiring and recruitment process.* 




*We are devoted to attracting the best talent worldwide to join our team and take pride in being an equal\-opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of religion, race, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, marital or parental status, disability, age, citizenship or other class protected by applicable law.*

****Welcome to PXGEO****
 PXGEO is an innovative marine geophysical service provider combining the strengths of ocean bottom and towed streamer seismic data acquisition techniques to deliver seamless subsurface imaging for a sustainable future.
   

  

****What's the role?****
 The official job title is Head of Sources and Mechanical Handling based in Dubai, UAE.
   

  

 The role is responsible for leading the seismic source, mechanical handling and NHV back deck activities of the Company to support the delivery of best\-in\-class fleet performance. Key responsibilities include:
   

  

* Mechanical handling, source and NHV technical support
* Manage a department of support staff (mechanical/Instrument and field\-based engineers) to provide first line technical and operational support to vessels and onshore departments as directed
* Maintain source, mechanical handling and NHV back deck specifications and standards for marine acquisition projects
* Develop, maintain, and improve the Company's seismic source, mechanical handling and NHV back deck technology and technique with a focus on environmental, safety, and operational efficiency and excellence
* Keep abreast of changes in source, mechanical handling and NHV back deck technology and proactively make recommendations to Management for enhanced service offerings
* Manage key suppliers of related technical services
* Monitor mechanical and back deck department spending, procurement and prepare budgetary forecasts for new technology
* Monitor mechanical and back deck related downtime across fleet and implement programs to reduce this as far as practical
* Develop and maintain Competency catalogue for the technical department personnel (onshore and offshore)
* Support Human Resources in the selection and development of mechanical and Instrument personnel
* Ensure that the Company management system is implemented, adhered to, measured, and improved by all in the related tech department organization
* Assist in responding to technical queries for tenders
* Assist in marketing in the related technical services to Clients.
* Frequent international travel, sometimes at short notice
* Occasional visits to, and onboard vessels
* Fulfill their assigned responsibilities as part of the Emergency Response team in line with the Emergency Response Plan and duty list as required


****Who are we looking for?****
* Has detailed knowledge of, and extensive experience with, marine seismic survey methods and technologies relating to towing and handling and sources
* At least degree level in an engineering or related discipline or equivalent experience
* As frequent travelers conduct vessel visits: BOSIET or FOET certification is required
