data.jd_text:
AESG is seeking an accomplished Principal Mechanical Engineer with deep expertise in mission\-critical facility design to join our growing Mission Critical department.
   

  

 Reporting directly to the Head of Mission Critical, this senior role offers significant career progression opportunities and the chance to lead diverse data center projects across the EMEA region, spanning full design delivery, technical advisory services, and contractor support during construction phases.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will combine technical excellence in mechanical systems design with proven client management skills, business development acumen, and the political savvy to navigate complex stakeholder environments.
   

  

 This is a leadership role for someone ready to take the next step in their career while maintaining hands\-on involvement across the full project lifecycle—from early\-stage advisory through design development to construction oversight and commissioning support.
   

  

**Qualification And Experience**
* 10\+ years of progressive experience in mechanical engineering design, with significant focus on data centre and mission\-critical facilities
* Demonstrated expertise in data centre mechanical systems, including chilled water plant design (chillers, pumps, distribution systems), air handling and distribution (CRAH/CRAC units, ducting, containment strategies), high\-density cooling solutions (direct liquid cooling, rear\-door heat exchangers), fire suppression systems (clean agent, water\-based), and energy\-efficient HVAC design incorporating economizers and free cooling strategies
* Strong technical foundation in load calculations, thermal modelling, pipe sizing, hydraulic calculations, and system balancing for mission\-critical environments
* Proven track record delivering projects for major data centre owners, operators, or developers, with experience across multiple project delivery models, including design\-build, design\-bid\-build, and advisory engagements
* Significant experience with projects in the GCC and broader EMEA region, with an understanding of regional codes, standards, and stakeholder dynamics
* Working knowledge of relevant mechanical engineering standards including ASHRAE (90\.1, TC 9\.9\), NFPA codes, and energy efficiency metrics (PUE, DCiE)
* Strong client relationship management skills with demonstrated ability to independently manage senior\-level client interactions and build lasting partnerships
* Business development experience, including proposal leadership, technical presentations, scope definition, and fee negotiation
* Demonstrated political acumen and ability to navigate complex organizational environments, manage competing stakeholder interests, and operate effectively in matrix structures
* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or related discipline; Chartered Engineer (CEng) or Professional Engineer (PE) status strongly preferred


**Responsibilities**
* Lead mechanical systems design for data centre and mission\-critical projects across various delivery models—from full design responsibility to technical advisory services and construction phase support—including cooling infrastructure (air\-cooled, liquid\-cooled, hybrid systems), HVAC, fire suppression, and plumbing systems
* Act as a senior client\-facing technical lead, managing relationships with data centre owners, operators, developers, and construction contractors throughout project lifecycles
* Provide technical advisory services to clients during procurement, design review, and construction phases, including contractor submittal reviews, RFI resolution, and technical assurance for project delivery
* Lead multidisciplinary coordination efforts, ensuring seamless integration between mechanical, electrical, architectural, structural, and other design disciplines
* Supervise, mentor, and develop engineering teams, providing technical guidance and fostering professional growth among junior and mid\-level engineers
* Support business development initiatives, including proposal preparation, technical presentations, fee negotiations, and strategic client engagement

We work to create an inclusive, high\-performing, and engaging environment where employees can grow, contribute meaningfully, and do their best work.  — Agoda’s front door for People support — supported by specialist service teams such as
 **People Relations Services** 
 . Together, these teams play a critical role in how employees and managers experience the People function day to day: through clear guidance, responsive support, effective issue resolution, and trusted handling of sensitive people matters.
   

  

**Opportunity**
 We are looking for an
 **Associate Director, Head of People Services \& Help Desk** 
 to lead Agoda’s employee\-facing People service delivery model across
 **People Help Desk / Tier 1 support** 
 ,
 **Tier 0 / self\-service foundations** 
 , and
 **Global People Relations Services** 
 .
   

  

 This is a key leadership role within People Experience and Services, responsible for shaping how employees and managers access support across a wide range of People topics — from day\-to\-day HR questions and lifecycle support to more complex and sensitive employee matters requiring specialist intervention.
   

  

 In this role, you will lead the teams responsible for:
   

  

* People Help Desk / Tier 1 services
* Tier 0 / self\-service and knowledge foundations
* Global People Relations Services, including case governance and specialist support for complex employee relations matters


 You will own the effectiveness of Agoda’s People support model from the employee and manager perspective, ensuring it is clear, trusted, scalable, and increasingly insight\-driven. This includes strengthening service standards, improving routing and handoffs across teams, enabling greater self\-service, and ensuring sensitive employee matters are handled with appropriate quality, consistency, and governance.
   

  

 This role is ideal for a leader who combines strong service delivery and operational leadership with sound judgment, systems thinking, and the ability to build a modern, scalable People support model in a global, fast\-moving organization.
   

  

 This position is based in
 **Bangkok** 
 . Agoda provides relocation support for successful candidates who are not currently located in Bangkok. Please note that we are
 **not open to remote work** 
 or the possibility of being based in other locations.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
**Lead Agoda’s People Services front door and employee support model**
* Lead Agoda’s employee\-facing People Services model across Tier 1 Help Desk support, Tier 0 self\-service, and the interface into specialist support teams.
* Define and evolve how employees and managers access support across People topics, ensuring a clear, seamless, and trusted experience.
* Establish strong service principles, operating rhythms, and leadership across the teams responsible for day\-to\-day People support and complex employee issue resolution.
* Ensure Agoda’s People support model scales effectively with organizational growth, complexity, and global reach.


**Lead the People Services \& Help Desk team**
* Lead, manage, and develop the People Services \& Help Desk team to deliver high\-quality, consistent, and empathetic Tier 1 support across core HR topics such as policies, processes, employee data, benefits, onboarding, leaves, mobility, and general employee lifecycle support.
* Set service standards, KPIs, quality expectations, and operating controls to ensure timely, accurate, and compliant case handling.
* Build a strong service culture with clear accountability for employee experience, right\-first\-time resolution, responsiveness, and professionalism.
* Oversee workforce planning, capacity management, and prioritization across service demand, seasonal peaks, and new People initiatives.


**Lead Global People Relations Services**
* Lead the Global People Relations Services team, ensuring high\-quality and well\-governed support across complex employee matters such as performance concerns, misconduct, grievances, investigations, disciplinary actions, involuntary exits, and employee matters arising from organizational change.
* Ensure clear service ownership, escalation pathways, and governance across People Relations case handling.
* Partner closely with HR Business Partners, Legal, Compliance, and other relevant stakeholders to ensure people relations matters are handled fairly, consistently, pragmatically, and in line with internal policies and local legal requirements.
* Drive high standards in case management, documentation, risk identification, and decision quality across the People Relations team.
* Use case trends and themes to inform improvements in manager guidance, policy design, service processes, and broader practices.


**Own the operating interfaces across Tier 1, People Relations, and specialist teams**
* Serve as the senior operational owner for how work flows between Help Desk / Tier 1, People Relations Services, and other Tier 2 / specialist teams across the People organization.
* Define and continuously improve routing logic, escalation models, intake criteria, handoffs, service ownership, and resolution pathways.
* Ensure employees and managers experience a joined\-up service model even when multiple People teams are involved.
* Clarify roles and interfaces across Help Desk, People Relations, Payroll, Rewards, Mobility, People Partners, CoEs, and other specialist teams.


**Build Tier 0 / self\-service and knowledge management foundations**
* Develop and execute Agoda’s roadmap for Tier 0 / self\-service, moving the organization toward more proactive, intuitive, and self\-directed resolution of common People queries.
* Own and strengthen the People knowledge ecosystem, including FAQs, help content, decision trees, agent guidance, and employee\-facing support materials.
* Partner with policy owners and People SMEs to simplify complex topics into clear, scalable, and user\-friendly content.
* Drive case deflection, knowledge reuse, content governance, and self\-service adoption through disciplined measurement and continuous improvement.


**Enable digital, conversational, and AI\-supported service delivery**
* Partner with Product, Tech, Systems, and Data teams to improve People support platforms, workflows, and user journeys across self\-service and case management.
* Identify and help shape practical use cases for conversational and agentic AI within People Services, ensuring they enhance employee experience and complement human support.
* Provide leadership input into the design, testing, rollout, and continuous refinement of AI\-enabled and digital service solutions.
* Ensure appropriate controls, privacy, escalation paths, and trust mechanisms are in place for all digital and AI\-supported support channels.


**Drive operational excellence and continuous improvement**
* Monitor and improve key service performance metrics across Help Desk and People Relations Services, such as case volume, first contact resolution, time to resolution, service quality, customer satisfaction, escalation rates, re\-open rates, and self\-service deflection.
* Lead ongoing improvements in workflows, playbooks, standard responses, training, quality assurance, and reporting.
* Partner with People Service Excellence and other stakeholders to simplify processes, remove friction, and improve end\-to\-end employee and manager experiences.
* Ensure effective controls, compliance, documentation standards, and data privacy practices are embedded across service operations.


**Lead through insight, stakeholder partnership, and change**
* Act as the senior People Services contact for service performance, priorities, risks, and transformation opportunities.
* Provide regular insight and reporting to People leaders on service trends, root causes, organizational pain points, and improvement opportunities.
* Partner with Communications and relevant People teams to coordinate messaging around policy changes, process updates, and new tools or services.
* Support broader People transformation by bringing an employee\-service lens to operating model design, simplification, and capability building across the function.


**What You’ll Need To Succeed**
* Bachelor’s degree in business, Human Resources, Operations, Law, Psychology, or a related field; advanced degree is a plus.
* Typically, 10\+ years of relevant experience across HR shared services, employee services, People operations, employee relations, HRBP, service delivery, or related functions, including significant leadership experience.
* Demonstrated experience leading managers and/or multiple service teams in a complex, matrixed, and fast\-paced environment.
* Strong experience running a service or support function with clear accountability for quality, responsiveness, service design, and stakeholder experience.
* Strong understanding of multi\-tier service delivery models, including Tier 0 / self\-service, Tier 1 support, and specialist / Tier 2 case management.
* Meaningful exposure to employee relations or complex people issue resolution, with sound judgment on sensitive matters and a strong appreciation for governance, risk, and consistency.
* Strong skills in service design, operating model improvement, process improvement, and cross\-functional workflow design.
* Experience with HR technology platforms and service tools such as HRIS, case management systems, knowledge bases, and digital support tools.
* Demonstrated ability to use data and analytics to monitor performance, identify themes and root causes, and drive prioritization and decision\-making.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to build trust and influence across leaders, specialist teams, and cross\-functional partners.
* Strong people leadership capability, including coaching leaders and managers, building team capability, and creating a high\-performance, service\-oriented culture.
* Comfort operating in a global, evolving, and ambiguous environment, with a strong bias for execution, improvement, and scale.


**It’s great if you also have**
* Experience in a global or regional HR shared services / People services environment.
* Experience leading both broad employee support teams and specialist employee relations or case management teams.
* Experience in knowledge management, service content strategy, and self\-service adoption.
* Hands\-on exposure to conversational AI, chatbots, virtual assistants, or workflow automation in HR or customer support environments.
* Experience improving employee experience through service redesign, process simplification, or digital product thinking.
* Experience in a high\-growth tech, internet, or digital business.
* Familiarity with global organizations operating across multiple countries, cultures, and regulatory environments.


**Why this role matters**
 This role is a unique opportunity to shape how Agoda employees and managers experience People support at scale. From everyday HR queries to more complex and sensitive employee matters, the teams in this scope play an important role in making sure our people feel supported, informed, and able to navigate key moments in their Agoda journey with confidence.
   

  

 As
 **Associate Director, Head of People Services \& Help Desk** 
 , you will help build a more connected, scalable, and future\-ready support model, improving service quality, strengthening self\-service, and ensuring complex cases are handled with care and consistency. Your work will directly influence employee experience, manager effectiveness, and how the People function continues to evolve as Agoda grows globally.

data.jd_text:
We're partnering with a rapidly scaling technology business that is transforming one of the region's largest and most complex industries through AI, automation, and data\-driven innovation.
 



  





 Backed by a well\-established regional group and operating with the agility of a startup, the company is building next\-generation products that are redefining how businesses and customers interact across a highly transactional environment.
 



  





 As part of its next phase of growth, the company is seeking an exceptional Head of Engineering to lead the technology function, shape engineering culture, and drive the execution of an ambitious AI\-powered product roadmap.
 



  





 This is a rare opportunity for a hands\-on engineering leader who thrives at the intersection of technology, product, and business.
 



  





 Reporting directly to the executive leadership team, you will take ownership of engineering strategy, team development, architecture, delivery excellence, and AI innovation. You will inherit a capable team and be responsible for elevating engineering standards, improving delivery velocity, and building a world\-class technology organization capable of scaling across the region.
 



  





 This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex business problems through technology, has experience building and scaling high\-performing engineering teams, and remains deeply involved in technical decision\-making.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* Define and execute the company's engineering vision and technical strategy.
* Lead, mentor, and scale a multi\-disciplinary engineering team across multiple locations.
* Drive engineering excellence, delivery quality, and operational effectiveness across all products and platforms.
* Establish modern software development practices, CI/CD processes, testing frameworks, monitoring, and observability standards.
* Partner closely with Product and Design leadership to deliver customer\-centric solutions and measurable business outcomes.
* Lead architectural decisions across web, mobile, backend, AI, and data platforms.
* Build and mature AI and automation capabilities, including agentic AI systems and intelligent workflow automation.
* Improve engineering productivity, release cadence, system reliability, and security posture.
* Develop strong technical leadership within the organization through coaching, succession planning, and selective hiring.
* Act as the senior technical voice within the leadership team, providing guidance on technology investments, risk management, scalability, and innovation.



  





 What We're Looking For
 


* 10\+ years of software engineering experience with at least 5 years leading engineering teams.
* Previous experience as a Head of Engineering, VP Engineering, CTO, Co\-Founder, or equivalent senior technology leadership role.
* Proven track record of scaling engineering organizations in high\-growth startup, scale\-up, or technology\-driven environments.
* Strong hands\-on technical background with the ability to review architecture, contribute to technical discussions, and guide engineering direction.
* Experience leading cross\-functional teams across product, design, engineering, and data functions.
* Strong understanding of modern software architecture, cloud technologies, distributed systems, and engineering best practices.
* Experience building products in fast\-paced environments where reliability, speed, and customer experience are critical.
* Demonstrated success improving software delivery processes, engineering culture, and operational maturity.



  





 Highly Desirable
 


* Production experience with AI\-powered products, LLM applications, agentic AI systems, or intelligent automation platforms.
* Experience working within SaaS, platform businesses, marketplaces, CRM ecosystems, or transaction\-heavy environments.
* Exposure to data infrastructure, analytics platforms, and AI\-driven product development.
* Startup founder or early\-stage leadership experience.
* Experience managing distributed engineering teams.



  





 Why Join?
 


* Opportunity to shape the future of a high\-growth technology business with significant market impact.
* Direct access to executive leadership and strategic decision\-making.
* Significant ownership, influence, and autonomy.
* Meaningful equity participation.
* Well\-funded environment with long\-term growth ambitions.
* Opportunity to build industry\-leading AI products and engineering capabilities.
* Collaborative, entrepreneurial culture with the pace and excitement of a startup.



  





 This is a career\-defining opportunity for a technology leader who wants to build, scale, and leave a lasting impact on a business undergoing significant transformation.
 



  





 Location: Dubai, UAE (Onsite)
 



  





 Candidates currently based in the UAE will be highly preferred.

data.jd_text:
**🚀 Head of Care\+ Ecosystem — Dubai HQ** 




 Trust Infrastructure for Device Financing in Emerging Markets
 



  





**Location:** 
 Dubai HQ (relocation) \+ regular business trips to operations countries
 



 (Nigeria, Kenya, Tanzania, Ghana, Uganda, and other emerging markets)
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time · Senior Leadership
 



**Start:** 
 ASAP
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are building trust infrastructure for device financing in emerging markets — where millions of customers finance smartphones but do not trust banks, services, or promises.
 



 Care\+ is not a warranty department.
 



  





 It is an ecosystem of trust around the device: replacement, refurbishment, anti\-fraud, service operations, and lifecycle management.
 



  





 We are looking for a Head of Care\+ Ecosystem — a founding\-level operational leader who will build and scale the entire after\-sales infrastructure across multiple countries.
 



  





 This role builds the department almost from zero — from 2 people to 8\+ senior team members during the first 18 months.
 



  





**What is Critically Important (must\-have experience)** 




 🔧
 **Device Certification** 




 — Practical experience in smartphone/consumer electronics certification in China
 



 — Real experience working with factories, certification labs, ODMs, and engineering teams
 



 — Understanding of factory documentation flow, typical bottlenecks, and “where things actually break.”
 



 — Experience with local device certification in Africa / SEA / LATAM countries
 



 — Understanding of local regulatory reality and launching devices in emerging markets
 



  





 📦
 **Spare Parts and Service Infrastructure** 




 — Deep understanding of spare parts movement and after\-sales logistics
 



 — Understanding of how spare parts actually move: factory → distributor → ASC → customer
 



 — Experience working with authorized service centers (ASC)
 



 — Understanding of SLA, replacement economics, refurbishment, and warranty operations
 



 — Understanding of local logistics reality in emerging markets, not only processes “on paper”
 



  





 🌍
 **Remote Management and Operational Audit** 




 — Proven experience in remote management of multi\-country service operations
 



 — Regular audits, inspections, and on\-site service center checks
 



 — Experience investigating:
 


* inventory leakage
* fake warranty claims
* fake parts
* grey market devices
* device swapping
* fake repairs



 — Ability to see the difference between reports and field reality
 



  





 👥
 **Hiring and Managing Local Managers** 




 — Experience hiring first\-level local Service / After\-Sales Managers
 



 — Ability to identify strong local operators “on the ground.”
 



 — Experience managing managers who work locally in\-country but functionally report to HQ
 



 — Experience building a controllable regional structure
 



 — Own network of service / after\-sales contacts in Africa or SEA is a major advantage
 



  





 📋
 **Standardization and Operational Discipline** 




 — Experience building standardized operational frameworks for multi\-country operations
 



 — Creation of SOPs, audit standards, escalation flows, and service protocols
 



 — Ability to establish consistent service quality across countries with different levels of market maturity
 



 — Ability to transform “manual management” into scalable operational infrastructure
 



 — Process discipline and reporting culture are non\-negotiable
 



  





**Strong Advantage** 




 — Experience working in the Dubai HQ of international companies
 



 — Experience working in: Nigeria, Kenya, Tanzania, Ghana, Uganda, Côte d’Ivoire, and other African countries
 



 — Experience in organizations such as Samsung, Transsion, Xiaomi, OPPO, vivo, realme, Huawei, HMD/Nokia
 



 — Understanding of how emerging markets operations really work outside corporate presentations
 



 — Experience in device financing / BNPL / smartphone financing ecosystems is a major advantage
 



  





**Basic Requirements** 




 — 8\+ years of experience in service / after\-sales / operations management
 



 — Multi\-country operations experience
 



 — Experience building and scaling teams
 



 — Strong analytical and operational mindset
 



 — English fluent (mandatory)
 



 — Willingness to travel: approximately 6–10 days/month during launch phase, with gradual reduction of travel load as operations scale
 



  





**Area of Responsibility** 




 — Building and managing the Care\+ ecosystem
 



 — Device certification in new markets
 



 — Development of service center network
 



 — Spare parts and refurbishment operations
 



 — Hiring, training, and functional management of local Service Managers
 



 — Anti\-fraud strategy and operational audit
 



 — Distributor and ASC relationship management
 



 — Building scalable operational infrastructure across multiple countries
 



  





**Compensation \& Growth** 




 — Senior\-level compensation structure discussed individually based on interview results
 



 — Includes fixed base, transparent KPI bonus structure, and long\-term participation opportunity
 



 — Transparent KPI mechanism
 



 — Grace period during the first 2 months
 



 — Dubai HQ leadership role
 



 — International multi\-country scope
 



 — Long\-term leadership growth opportunity within the ecosystem
 



  





**Career Path** 




 Year 1–2: Head of Care\+ Ecosystem
 



 Year 2–3: VP Care\+ Operations
 



 Year 3\+: COO\-track / senior ecosystem leadership
 



  





**What is Important for This Role** 




 We are looking for someone who:
 



 — understands the difference between reports and reality
 



 — knows how to build controllable operations
 



 — is capable of building discipline and standards
 



 — can operate in the complex field reality of emerging markets
 



 — can simultaneously manage people, processes, and risks
 



  





 If you know how to build a controllable after\-sales infrastructure in environments where processes on paper and processes in reality are two different things, we would like to speak with you.

 Take the lead and we’ll give you the support you need to be at the top of your game. And we offer you the freedom to be a positive disrupter and turn big ideas into bold, industry\-changing realities.
   

  

 For our business, for clients, and for you
   

  

**REGIONAL HEAD OF OPERATIONS – CLOSE ENDED (MIDDLE EAST)**
**Location: UAE**
**About Apex:**
 The Apex Group is a global financial services provider with over 13,000 employees across 85 offices globally. We look to recruit bright, articulate, and numerate employees who are not afraid of a challenge and are prepared to work hard and love what they do.
   

  

 Every employee plays a part in making Apex who we are today and the more we grow, the more important that becomes. Whatever your career path or specialism, Apex provides a global platform to allow you to thrive.
   

  

**The role:**
 Apex Group has created a regionalised operational organisation structure, divided into sub\-product segments, that enables Apex to sustain service delivery levels of the highest standards and maximize productivity and efficiencies.
   

  

 In this position you will be responsible for the end\-to\-end operational performance of the closed\-ended funds business in the different countries within the Middle East region, reporting to the Regional head of Fund Solutions – MEAIM.
   

  

 You should have extensive experience in the administration of close\-ended funds. You should have a proven track record of demonstrating your knowledge of fund accounting and a proven track record in leading multi\-jurisdictional operational platforms.. The role requires a strong combination of operational leadership, client delivery excellence, commercial awareness and transformation capability.
   

  

**Technical Tasks:**
* Oversee and lead the end\-to\-end delivery of the fund accounting service for close\-ended funds, ensuring accuracy and compliance with fund governing documents and regulatory guidance.
* Provide leadership on complex client and operational matters requiring senior judgment.
* Ensure full adherence to the prevailing control environment.
* Be a leading participant in the continuous development of our operating processes and procedures.
* Be an escalation point for technical queries from all stakeholders in your region.
* Oversee the timely completion of all audits.
* Ensure local teams’ adherence to regulatory compliance and underlying reporting.


**Tasks/Responsibilities:**

* Team collaboration across multiple jurisdictions globally including global operations centres and ensure that client deliverables are being met.

* Contribute to the achievement of regional financial and operational performance targets.
* Ensure effective \& timely resolutions to any errors identified.
* KPI’s to be consistently above the specified target for each team in your region (accuracy, timeliness, and delivery)
* Team capacity planning and full awareness of incoming pipeline, including ownership of hire requests.
* People management with a focus on development, motivation, and succession planning/talent management.
* Identify training needs within your teams in the region and interact with our training department.
* Manage employee performance and salary review process.

* Ensure adherence to all internal and external audit standards.
* Ensure stakeholder awareness, engagement, and support through effective and timely communication.
* Actively support Groups strategy, plans, and values, contributing to the achievement of a high\-performance culture.
* Demonstrate visible leadership and promote collaboration and accountability across the multi\-jurisdictional teams.
* Develop, maintain and role model a culture that is open to change and innovation, and supports collaboration, respect, and accountability.
* Maintain knowledge of industry trends.


**Skills Required:**
* Bachelor or Master level degree.
* Strong accountancy knowledge, a professional designation such as CA, CPAA, or ACCA etc., would be an asset.
* Solid experience working with private markets / closed\-ended fund structures across multiple jurisdictions.
* Extensive practical experience, 15\+ years of fund accounting work experience.
* Experience managing a large team / managing regional or multi\-location teams.
* Extensive experience working with external clients and an ability to inspire confidence.
* Excellent communication skills and proficiency in English (both verbal and written).
* Motivated, bright, and diligent individual who is driven to meet deadlines \& targets.
* Attention to detail and ability to work on multiple projects.
* A team player who is genuinely motivated by improving our service and teams.
* An ability to think critically and objectively while having strong organizational and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to resolve complex issues in a timely manner.
* Advanced level MS Excel, proficient with MS Word, MS PowerPoint.
* A detailed understanding of the various fund types covered by this role (Private Equity, Real Estate, Credit \& Venture Capital).


**What you will get in return:**
* A unique opportunity to be part of an expanding large global business and to lead teams across different locations.
* A friendly, co\-operative, and supportive environment.
* Exposure to many different fund types and a wide variety of clients.
* An opportunity to make an impact in a leading product for Apex.
* Training and development opportunities.

data.jd_text:
talabat is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in over 70\+ countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Who We Are?**
 When you think of food delivery in the MENA region, we’d be pretty surprised if talabat didn’t pop into your mind first! Since delivering our first order in Kuwait in 2004, we’ve grown quite a lot over the past 17 years.
   

  

 Today, we deliver hundreds of millions of food orders, grocery items and other products per year, to our customers in nine countries throughout the region with more than 3,000\+ employees! Our food delivery business works with over 27,000 brands and almost 50,000 branches, while our q\-commerce concept, talabat mart, now delivers groceries to customers in Bahrain, Egypt, Jordan, Kuwait, Oman Qatar, and the UAE in 30 minutes or less!
   

  

 Our philosophy is to make sure we do what is right for our ecosystem \- our customers, our partners, our people, our riders, and the communities in which we operate. Our \#techforgood program allows our customers a safe and convenient way to contribute to important causes in their community through donating to local and international charities directly on talabat with a focus on food insecurity in the region. Since its inception in 2020, we have facilitated the donation of well over 1 million meals to those in need, as well as donated over $1\.5 million to charity with the help of our partners and customers. talabat is part of Delivery Hero, the global leader in online food delivery and q\-commerce.
   

  

**Role Summary**
* Owns regional value creation, translating strategic priorities into clear commercial initiatives with measurable impact.
* Leads complex, cross\-market programs, ensuring rigorous project management, senior\-level alignment, and disciplined execution.
* Establishes scalable commercial frameworks, enabling consistent decision\-making while preserving local market flexibility.
* Drives insight\-led decisions through advanced analytics, turning data into clear, actionable recommendations.
* Shapes executive dialogue, influencing stakeholders through structured communication and fact\-based narratives.
* Deploys technology as a performance lever, improving productivity, transparency, and speed to impact.

Handles critical decisions such as market entry strategies, pricing adjustments, and operational improvements with a focus on sustainable results. implements processes that empower teams to identify and address challenges independently.

**About us**




  





 Join the UAE’s largest bank and one of the world’s largest and safest financial institutions. Our focus is to create value for our employees, customers, shareholders and communities to grow through differentiation, agility and innovation. We are looking for top talent and your success is our success. Accelerate your growth as you help us reach our goals and advance your career. Be ready to make your mark a top company, in an exciting \& dynamic industry.
 



  





**Job Purpose**




 To manage and grow large account portfolios and client relationships for assigned portfolio in the Corporate banking segment; improve service quality levels and supervise the subordinates’ day\-to\-day activities and client interactions to ensure that the objectives are constantly met and its revenue targets achieved, while maintaining client satisfaction and portfolio credit quality. High collaboration required internally and externally, with local and international client outreach (includes meetings in different time zones and tight deadline submissions). A highly engaged person who can drive the business and internal processes to ensure approvals are sought in a short time span.
 



  





**Responsibilities**




  





**Client and Market Analysis** 



* Participate in the financial analysis conducted on clients and their respective industries/ markets to identify potential opportunities and risks.



  





**Client Relationship Management** 



* Originate new business opportunities with target clients across banking products
* Develop Term Sheet, Information Memorandum, mandate letter….etc.;
* Examine \& resolve credit, market and operational risk aspects of the transactions in collaboration with products and enablement units.
* Pitch, review, negotiate and conclude deals.
* Maintain the credit quality of the client relationships within the Portfolio to an acceptable level set by the Bank’s management.
* Achieve individual and team’s financial performance targets.
* Identify \& develop cross selling opportunities and increase the cross\-sell ratio with key clients.
* Ensure Account Plans are prepared and maintained for all key clients.
* Ensure all clients’ files /documents are maintained.
* Ensure all credit reviews are submitted on time and agreed conditions are met.
* Maintain a satisfactory audit on the portfolio
* Learning \& Development – Attend appropriate on and off\-the\-job training programs.
* Ensure that all internal processes for existing portfolio and NTBs are met in line with the Bank’s policies \& procedures.

**Day\-to\-Day Activities** 



* Assist the Executive Director / Line Manager in the day\-to\-day administrative and transactional activities such as client calls, payment processing, documentation follow up, account openings, updating pipeline, and any other activities in the unit/team to ensure continuity of work and the delivery of effective and high\-quality outputs.

* Knowledge of the banking sector, and FAB’s products and business strategies

* Computer proficiency

* Banking software systems proficiency
* Data analysis and financial modelling skills
* Credit analysis and FOREX skills
* Communication skills



  





**Minimum Experience** 



* 8\-10 years of experience in corporate banking (coverage).

* Clarifies key stakeholders' product specific value propositions.
* Match pricing target with key stakeholders' value propositions.

* Required : Advanced Degree in Science, Economics or related areas.

* Robust understanding of national reimbursement authorities including localized decisions and the ongoing changes that could affect the commercial goals.
* Demonstrable track record in working with KOLs/reimbursement stakeholders in influencing product guidelines, removing barriers to ensure products are used in key centers.
* Market Access experience preferably within Medical Devices/Pharma sector.
* Tender Management experience.
* Demonstrated ability to influence relationships and leverage knowledge internally across a matrix structure to optimize opportunities with customers and achieve shared goals.
* Ability to influence internally at all levels without line management authority.
* Ability to influence external customers at all levels.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* IT literate.


**Impact of position**
* Identify emerging business opportunities.
* Sales/ profit targets.
* Success in particular assigned projects.
* Win particular accounts.

Shamal Holding is a diversified investment firm that cultivates the extraordinary. Born in Dubai, we curate a unique portfolio of extraordinary investments, experiences and assets to generate meaningful outcomes. The investments we make are strategically chosen and thoughtfully nurtured, mirroring Dubai’s ambition, spirit and energy. As a global investor, asset owner and developer we utilise our resources, know\-how and connections, to deliver long\-term value, wherever we operate. Our portfolio spans Lifestyle \& Entertainment, Destinations, Real Estate, Hospitality, and F\&B, including Skydive Dubai, Deep Dive Dubai, XDubai, Dubai Harbour, Kite Beach and more.
   

  

 As Shamal Holding continues to grow, we’re in search of a
 **Manager \- Communications** 
 . In this role you will support the Director of PR \& Communications in shaping and protecting the corporate reputation of the Group, driving strategic communications across the holding entity and its portfolio, and strengthening executive visibility through structured media engagement and thought leadership positioning.
   

  

 The role will lead media relations and external communications strategy across both corporate (B2B/investment) and B2C portfolio narratives, while overseeing execution through Manager/Assistant Managers responsible for internal and external communications.
   

  

**Corporate Communications Strategy**
* Support the Director in developing and implementing an integrated corporate communications strategy aligned with the Group’s investment mandate and long\-term vision.
* Articulate the Group’s investment philosophy, portfolio growth narrative, and economic contribution in a clear, consistent manner.
* Ensure alignment of messaging across business verticals and portfolio entities.
* Contribute to positioning the Group as a credible, forward\-looking investment platform regionally and internationally.


**Executive \& Thought Leadership Positioning**
* Develop and execute a structured CEO and executive spokesperson positioning plan.
* Identify high\-impact speaking opportunities, editorial placements, and industry forums.
* Draft speeches, op\-eds, interviews, and key messaging for senior leadership.
* Build a sustained thought leadership platform aligned with strategic priorities and national development narratives.


**Media Relations \& Reputation Management**
* Own relationships with key regional and international media outlets.
* Develop proactive media engagement strategies to strengthen brand equity and share of voice.
* Manage media briefings, interviews, and press interactions.
* Lead crisis communications planning and response in coordination with the Director.
* Monitor media coverage and sentiment, providing strategic insights and risk mitigation recommendations.


**Investment \& Portfolio Communications**
* Translate complex investment activity into compelling narratives suitable for media, stakeholders, and public audiences.
* Support announcement strategies for acquisitions, partnerships, launches, and major milestones.
* Oversee development of press materials, corporate statements, and media kits.
* Ensure portfolio brands’ communications align with Group reputation standards.


**B2C PR \& Brand Communications**
* Drive public\-facing PR strategies across lifestyle, real estate, hospitality, and experiential assets within the portfolio.
* Collaborate with Marketing teams to amplify major launches and initiatives.
* Ensure consistent brand storytelling across earned media channels.


**Internal Communications Oversight**
* Provide direction to Assistant Manager \- Internal Communications to ensure consistent messaging across the organization.
* Support leadership communications, town halls, and employee engagement initiatives.
* Ensure internal narratives align with external positioning.


**Governance \& Compliance**
* Establish and maintain communications governance frameworks.
* Ensure message discipline and approval processes are adhered to across the Group.
* Maintain crisis communications protocols and escalation pathways.


**Agency \& Partner Management**
* Oversee PR agency performance, scope alignment, and strategic direction.
* Manage budgets allocated to communications initiatives.
* Ensure agencies deliver measurable media impact aligned with corporate objectives.
* Bachelor’s degree in communications, Public Relations, Journalism, or related field.
* 10\-14 years of experience in corporate communications, public relations, or reputation management.
* Experience within an investment firm, sovereign wealth fund, holding company, or large diversified conglomerate preferred.
* Demonstrated experience supporting executive leadership positioning.
* Proven track record managing high\-level media engagement and complex announcements.


**Personal Attributes**
* High credibility and executive presence.
* Discreet, politically astute, and trusted with sensitive information.
* Calm and decisive under pressure.
* Strategic thinker with strong operational discipline.
* Commercially aware with understanding of investment environments.
* Collaborative leader capable of guiding junior communications professionals.


**For more information about Shamal, please visit our LinkedIn page** 
 https//www.linkedin.com/company/shamalholding/
   

  

**Note**
 Due to a high influx of profiles, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

 Marketing \& Campaign Development
 


* Lead the conceptualization and execution of integrated marketing campaigns, product launches, seasonal activations, and promotional initiatives.

* Collaborate closely with marketing teams to create impactful customer engagement strategies.

 Product \& Packaging Innovation
 


* Direct the creative development of perfume packaging, gifting solutions, product presentation, and visual merchandising.

data.jd_text:
**Scope**
 The Asset Director will play a key strategic role within Skyways Technics, as part of the company’s senior management team, overseeing the full lifecycle management of high\-value assets such as aircraft, engines and landing gears. Reporting directly to the VP Assets, this position is responsible for defining, executing, and continuously optimizing the company’s asset strategy to ensure alignment with market demand, commercial objectives, and long\-term profitability.
   

  

 The role combines strategic asset portfolio management, high\-level commercial decision\-making, and global business development. The Asset Director will actively identify acquisition opportunities, evaluate technical and financial risks, and structure transactions that maximize asset value.
   

  

 Acting as a senior commercial leader, the Asset Director will maintain direct relationships with key customers, prospects, and partners worldwide, while providing transversal leadership to international sales teams. The role requires continuous engagement with the global aviation aftermarket through trade fairs, industry events, and ongoing networking, ensuring Skyways Technics remains well\-positioned to anticipate market trends and seize emerging opportunities.
   

  

 In addition to commercial and strategic responsibilities, the Asset Management Director will ensure rigorous documentation and compliance standards across all assets, including comprehensive traceability and maintenance history reviews. Regular reporting to senior management will support informed decision\-making at executive level, with clear visibility on asset performance, market conditions, risks, and profitability.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Manage the company’s asset portfolio to ensure alignment with market needs and commercial strategy.
* Control and optimize total inventory value with a strong focus on profitability and cash flow.
* Lead the asset acquisition team responsible to identify, evaluate, and acquire second\-hand aircraft (ATR, A320, B737\) or airframe. Including the negotiation of the most favorable commercial terms with potential sellers (lessors, airlines etc.), from LOI draft review to execution of the SPA.
* Source and acquire landing gears and engines available on the global market.
* Oversee documentation reviews, including but not limited to Back\-to\-Birth traceability and shop visit history.
* Sell, Lease, Exchange landing gears and engines to existing customers and new prospects.
* Maintain direct commercial relationships with customers and key accounts.
* Leverage and expand an existing network within the commercial aviation aftermarket.
* Develop and strengthen strategic partnerships while identifying new partners.
* Prepare business cases and cash flow scenarios for asset acquisitions and projects.
* Monitor and report on the profitability and performance of projects and assets.
* Provide transversal leadership and coordination of global sales teams.
* Act as a senior commercial leader, driving collaboration and priorities across region and manage the sale \& lease of assets directly or indirectly (using the local sales teams).
* Report regularly to higher management on asset performance, market trends, and opportunities.
* Represent Skyways Technics at trade fairs, industry events, and conferences.
* Conduct continuous market intelligence and networking to identify opportunities and trends.
* Provide regular sales forecasts, reports, and insights to senior management to inform strategic decision\-making.
* Participate in the company’s senior management meetings (online and in person).
* Travel regularly to visit customers and stakeholders (average of 20% travel time expected)


**Skills \& Added Qualification Requirements**
* Fluent in English speaking, reading, and writing
* Experienced in Narrowbody \& ATR aircraft, engines and landing gears
* Meticulous, organized and accurate
* Effective communication
* Strong interpersonal skills, self\-motivated and performance driven
* Curious, willing to take calculated risks
* Multi\-tasker, Hands on and Team Player
* Experience in selling B2B services, especially for repairing and selling aircraft components
* An existing network of customers in commercial aviation aftermarket sector

 This role ensures that City Technology programs and vendors deliver technology solutions in a controlled, auditable manner, and that all deliverables meet defined governance requirements for readiness, documentation, cybersecurity gating, and transition into
 **technology L2/L3 support** 
 .
   

  

 The PMO acts as the control tower for all City Technology projects transitioning into run\-state operations.
   

  

**Reporting Line**
 Reports to:
 **Director — Technology Governance, Architecture, Budget, ITSM Standards \& PMO**
**Direct Reports:** 
 PMO Managers, Project Governance Leads, Reporting \& Controls Analysts
   

  

**Role Scope (City Technology Only)**
**In scope delivery and handover domains, including, but not limited to:**
* City Business Applications
* City Platforms (integration/IoT/data)
* City OT \& Smart Systems technology
* City Physical Security technology
* City ICT infrastructure and data centers including City IT/OT Security


**Key Responsibilities**
* Delivery \& Handover Governance Framework (City Technology)
* Implement and maintain Delivery \& Handover Governance standards for City Technology programs, including:
+ reporting templates and cadence
+ stage\-gate criteria
+ RAID log standards
+ dependency tracking rules
+ baseline control requirements (scope/schedule/cost)

* Ensure all delivery teams and vendors comply with governance controls
* Integrated Program Controls
* Maintain an integrated view of City Technology delivery progress across towers and suppliers
* Track delivery milestones, critical path items, and cross\-tower dependencies
* Identify schedule slippage, scope creep, and delivery risk early and escalate through governance forums
* Stage Gates \& Assurance (Delivery\-to\-Run)
* Govern and enforce delivery stage gates, including:
* Design completion readiness (as required by TDAs)
* Testing and commissioning evidence
* Documentation and as\-built readiness
* Operational readiness evidence for transition into technology support
* Ensure no system progresses through gates without evidence and sign\-offs


**City Business Applications**
**City OT \& Smart Systems**
**City Physical Security Systems**
**City Platforms (Integration / IoT / Data)**
**City ICT Infrastructure and Data Centers including City IT/OT Security**
* Risk, Issues, and Dependency Governance (RAID)
* Own RAID governance standards across all City Technology delivery programs
* Ensure RAID logs are complete, current, and actionable
* Run dependency reviews and cross\-tower issue resolution sessions
* Escalate unresolved risks/issues to the appropriate governance level
* Delivery Reporting \& Executive Packs
* Produce standardized delivery reporting packs including:
* Schedule health (RAG)
* Delivery risk exposure
* Dependency hotspots
* Milestone achievement
* Vendor delivery performance indicators
* Readiness risks for transition to technology support
* Ensure reporting is auditable and consistent across towers
* Vendor Delivery \& Handover Governance Support (non\-commercial)
* Ensure vendors comply with City Technology Delivery \& Handover Governance requirements:
+ Reporting cadence
+ Evidence packs
+ Stage\-gate readiness
+ Documentation standards

* Provide delivery performance evidence to:
+ Commercials/Vendor Management function (for contract governance)
+ City Technology leadership (for escalation)

* Alignment to Governance, Architecture, and Cybersecurity
* Ensure delivery programs comply with:
+ corporate technology governance processes (where applicable)
+ City Technology governance and architecture standards
+ design authority requirements (IT/OT/physical security/platforms/data)
+ cybersecurity gating requirements
+ Track and report exceptions and required waivers through the correct forums


**Key Interfaces**
**Internal:**
* Director — City Technology Governance \& Architecture
* Tower Directors (Apps / OT / Physical Security / Platforms / Infrastructure / Cybersecurity)
* City ITSM governance and assurance function
* Director — City Technology Operations (City) (for transition readiness alignment only)
* Finance / budgeting governance stakeholders


**External:**
* Systems Integrators
* Delivery contractors
* OEMs providing commissioning and handover support
* Managed service providers supporting transition planning


**Success Measures (KPIs)**
* % of City Technology programs compliant with Delivery \& Handover Governance reporting cadence
* Stage\-gate compliance rate (% passing with complete evidence)
* % of projects with maintained baseline (scope/schedule/cost)
* Delivery risk closure rate (RAID actions completed on time)
* Number of uncontrolled scope changes / late change requests
* Reduction in "handover defects" (missing documentation, missing runbooks, missing monitoring)
* Reduction in incidents caused by poor delivery transition within first 30 days of go\-live


**Operational Readiness \& Handover Governance**
* Define acceptance criteria for transition from Project to Operations
* Ensure support documentation, runbooks, monitoring, SLAs and vendor contracts are in place
* Validate security hardening and compliance sign\-offs
* Coordinate CAB approvals and go\-live governance
* Confirm training and knowledge transfer completion


**Portfolio \& Financial Governance**
* Track total technology investment portfolio (CAPEX and transformation OPEX)
* Align with Finance for forecasting accuracy
* Monitor cost variance and earned value performance
* Maintain benefits realization tracking framework


**Stakeholder Management**
* Engage Directors across all City Technology tower
* Interface with Corporate PMO and Enterprise Architecture
* Present executive updates to Technology Steering Committee
* Coordinate with Procurement and Legal for contract governance alignment


**Requirements**
* 15\+ year\-experience in large\-scale ICT infrastructure, smart city, or complex technology Delivery \& Handover Governance / PMO / program controls roles
* Experience in complex multi\-domain environments, ideally including:
+ IT \+ OT programs
+ infrastructure and data centers
+ physical security technology delivery
+ smart city platforms and integration

* Strong knowledge of:
+ stage\-gate Delivery \& Handover Governance
+ RAID management
+ dependency management
+ reporting and executive governance packs

* Strong stakeholder management and escalation skills
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, IT, Computer Science or related field (Master's preferred)
* Experience managing IT \+ OT delivery environments preferred
* Strong experience in governance\-heavy or giga\-project environments
* PMP or equivalent certification required
* Agile/Scrum or SAFe certification preferred
* ITIL knowledge required
* Strong financial governance and executive reporting capability

**Job Description**
 The Senior Commercial Director for KSA, Bahrain, and Kuwait is responsible for shaping and executing a long‑term (3–5 year) commercial strategy with a strong focus on accelerating growth in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia—one of Hilton’s most strategically important markets, expected to exceed 100 hotels within five years.
   

  

 This role leads the development of the value proposition and investment cases required to unlock this growth, ensuring the right commercial foundations are established across Sales, Marketing, Distribution, and Revenue functions. The appointee will assess organizational design needs, budget requirements, talent capabilities, and performance enablers needed for sustained market leadership.
   

  

 The Senior Commercial Director is accountable for delivering top‑tier commercial performance across the three markets and driving market share growth. The role includes hiring, developing, and mentoring high‑potential talent, ensuring alignment with Hilton’s strategic priorities while fostering a culture that reflects Hilton’s values.
   

  

 A critical success factor is the ability to build strong, influential partnerships with senior commercial leaders, regional and brand teams, GMs, ownership groups, and cross‑functional stakeholders. The role requires exceptional communication, analytical rigor, and strategic thinking to solve complex business challenges and enable sustained success.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**What will I be doing?**
**Business Acumen**
* Partner with the VP Commercial Services and Commercial Director MEA to develop long‑term regional strategy, business cases, and stakeholder alignment.
* Serve as the commercial business partner to the VP Operations for KSA, Bahrain, and Kuwait.
* Lead, coach, and develop the Commercial Director, enabling them to own near‑term tactical execution.
* Support new hotel openings from a commercial perspective, leveraging Hilton’s full commercial engine (RMCC, HWS, shared sales offices, Marketing, F\&B, HRCC).
* Translate organizational goals into clear performance standards for the Commercial Services team.


**Setting Strategy**
* Develop medium‑ and long‑term commercial strategies to drive sustained, above‑market revenue performance across all three markets.
* Clearly communicate strategic priorities, progress, and results to internal and external stakeholders.
* Gain senior‑level alignment and sponsorship for key initiatives required to deliver strategic outcomes.
* Lead strategic planning within the Commercial Services team to advance enterprise goals and ensure consistent communication.


**Executing for Results**
* Lead negotiations with third‑party partners and suppliers as required.
* Collaborate cross‑functionally with Revenue, Sales, F\&B, Marketing, eCommerce, and Finance teams, as well as commercial leadership across MEA and EMEA.
* Ensure all commercial initiatives are effectively planned, resourced, and executed.
* Drive integrated commercial action across functions to maximize RevPAR and market share.


**Leading Teams**
* Ensure Commercial Services teams provide strong support to on‑property commercial teams.
* Build and maintain a high‑performing talent pipeline, developing future leaders and succession plans.
* Create a culture of performance, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.


**Building Relationships and Influencing**
* Develop strong relationships across senior leadership to enable alignment and collaboration.
* Strengthen partnerships with MEA and EMEA commercial teams to elevate commercial performance.
* Maintain effective coordination with global commercial functions, including Database Management, HRCC, Distribution, and Channel Management.
* Represent the commercial function at property visits, corporate meetings, owner meetings, and business reviews.


**Qualifications**
**What are we looking for?**
* Demonstrated experience operating at a regional level with responsibility for a portfolio of no fewer than 20 hotels, including oversight of commercial performance, stakeholder engagement, and strategic execution across multiple countries. Proven track record in high‑growth markets, ideally with exposure to environments experiencing 4x\+ growth rates, where rapid scaling, agility, and commercial innovation are essential.
* Strong relationship building skills
* Ability to effectively plan and proactively communicate/manage expectations with stakeholders that may include both internal and external partners (project sponsors/ senior leadership team)
* Experience in working in a matrix organization
* Experience in Revenue Management, Sales \& Marketing
* Presents clear and logical arguments and decision based on factual data.
* Quick and accurate when evaluating complex written and numerical information.
* Develops constructive relationships at all levels within the organization.
* Demonstrates leadership and effectively motivates teams, helps others when needed.
* Maintains effectiveness in situations of disappointment or high pressure.
* Adapts willingly to change.
* Identifies priorities effectively, balancing importance, urgency and resources.
* Manages own personal time efficiently within tight schedules.
* Strategic thinker while translating financial goals into operational plans
* Previous experience in Change management and organisational design.
* Storytelling and ability to create, business cases, presentations to gain stakeholder buy\-in.
* Dynamic, innovative, and creative in finding business solutions
* Works effectively and accurately in a fast\-paced environment.
* Ability to challenge while maintaining strong relationships
* A high level of emotional intelligence and interpersonal skills with the ability to provide and receive professional, constructive feedback that elevates individual performance and job satisfaction


**About The Team**
**How We’ll Help You Thrive**
**Benefits**
 At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including\*:
   

  

 Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40 USD/night at our world\-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
   

  

 Paid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents
   

  

 Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care
   

  

 Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Through our Care for All hub, we provide resources to help our Team Members to care for themselves and their loved ones. In many countries, eligible Team Members receive free counseling and support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
   

  

* Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

data.jd_text:
**Responsibilities**
 TikTok LIVE connects creators and communities in real time, enabling interactive experiences and new monetisation opportunities. As part of TikTok’s regional management and support function, the Regional Headquarters is seeking a Regional Agency Strategy, Governance and Enablement Manager to support TikTok group entities across the MENAT region. The role will support the development of regional agency\-management strategy, training, performance analytics, policy implementation and operational governance, with local execution undertaken by the relevant operating entities.
   

  

 Responsibilities:
   

 1\. Develop, maintain and support implementation of regional agency\-management policies, playbooks, onboarding standards and governance processes for TikTok LIVE across the MENA/MENAT region.
   

 2\. Support local operating entities in identifying, assessing and managing MCNs, agencies and creator organisations in accordance with approved regional standards, without directly contracting on behalf of the RHQ entity.
   

 3\. Design and deliver regional training materials and enablement programmes for internal teams on agency\-management processes, platform policies, compliance requirements and operational best practices.
   

 4\. Analyse regional agency performance data and provide recommendations to local operating entities and regional leadership on agency quality, category development and creator ecosystem trends.
   

 5\. Coordinate with product, policy, legal, compliance and local operations teams to improve regional agency\-management methodology and ensure consistent application of TikTok LIVE standards.
   

 6\. Contribute to regional business planning, operational governance and performance reporting for the LIVE creator agency ecosystem.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Minimum Qualifications:
   

 \- Bachelor's degree or above.
   

 \- Deep passion for TikTok, mobile entertainment, social media, and popular culture.
   

 \- Experience in the live\-streaming industry and understanding of latest live\-streaming trends.
   

 \- Experience in regional strategy, business operations, governance, analytics, partner enablement or cross\-functional programme management within a technology, media, entertainment, social media or creator economy business.
   

  

 This role is based in the Company’s KSA Regional Headquarters and is responsible for providing regional strategy, management, governance, analytics, training and coordination support to Company group entities across the MENAT/MENA region. The role does not involve direct sales to customers, direct contracting with creators, agencies or users on behalf of the RHQ entity, or direct operation of local commercial activities. Execution of local market activities, contracting and revenue\-generating operations remains with the relevant local operating entities.
   

  

**About TikTok**
 TikTok is the leading destination for short\-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.​
   

  

  

**Why Join Us**
 Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy \- a mission we work towards every day.​
   

 We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
   

 ​
   

 Diversity \& Inclusion​
   

 TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​

**Build the Future of Rail in the Middle East with Mace**
 As we expand our rail capability across the Middle East, Mace is seeking exceptional talent to help shape and deliver some of the region’s most ambitious transport programmes.
   

  

 With a globally recognised track record across high‑speed rail, conventional rail, metro, and complex station environments, we are now growing our presence in the region — and building a high‑calibre talent pool to support this next phase.
   

  

**We Are Looking For Experienced Professionals Across**
* Project and Programme Management
* Cost and Commercial Management
* Project Controls and Planning


**You’ll Be Responsible For**
* Directs the coordination and delivery of programmes, aligning project execution with defined strategic objectives, vision, and outcomes.
* Establishes and maintains an effective programme delivery environment across people, organisational structure, processes, information, and technology.
* Drives performance improvement beyond baseline targets through optimisation of resources and continuous monitoring, evaluation, and refinement of systems and methodologies.
* Leads governance of safety, quality, cost, schedule, risk, sustainability, compliance, and stakeholder management to ensure consistent delivery excellence.
* Maintains comprehensive programme documentation, including plans, procedures, reports, registers, and lessons learned to support informed decision\-making.
* Builds and leads high\-performing, inclusive teams, fostering collaboration, engagement, and a culture of service excellence and continuous improvement.
* Manages key internal and external stakeholder relationships, strengthening communication, engagement, and long\-term network development.
* Ensures commercial viability and alignment with organisational objectives, while embedding innovation, digital transformation, and sustainability principles, including net zero carbon delivery.


**About You**
 You will bring proven experience in major rail or infrastructure programmes, coupled with the ability to operate in complex, fast‑paced delivery environments. Equally important is a collaborative mindset and a commitment to excellence — qualities that define how we partner with our clients and deliver lasting impact.
   

  

 This is an opportunity to be part of something evolving — to help establish, shape, and grow a rail capability in a region where investment in integrated transport is accelerating at pace.
   

  

 If you are motivated by delivering complex programmes, working with high‑performing teams, and contributing to the development of world‑class infrastructure, we would welcome the opportunity to connect.
   

  

 Join us in delivering the next generation of rail across the Middle East.

 Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.
   

  

 We are majority\-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner \& Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.
   

  





 Please visit our website: www.turnerandtownsend.com

 We are seeking an experienced and driven Associate Director for our cost management services across multi\-sector projects in Riyadh. This role requires strong leadership, strategic thinking and the ability to manage both internal and external stakeholders effectively.

This role requires a forward\-thinking, visionary leader who can navigate a dynamic, multicultural environment while driving operational excellence and long\-term business impact.

* Develop and execute the commercial strategy for the MENA Instruments business to achieve sustainable revenue and market share growth.

* Contribute to long\-term strategic planning, including market expansion, organizational development, and future growth initiatives.
* Lead through change with agility and adaptability in a fast\-paced and evolving business environment.


**What will you need:**
**Required:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Healthcare, Life Sciences, or a related field.
* Minimum 10 years of commercial experience, including minimum 3\-5 years in leadership roles within a multinational medical device company.

* Experience building and scaling teams, including developing organizations from the ground up.
* Strong strategic mindset with the ability to plan and execute long\-term business objectives over a 2–3 year horizon.
* Demonstrated success managing multicultural teams and working effectively across diverse markets and cultures.
* Strong business acumen with excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to adapt and lead effectively within a dynamic and changing organization.
